gist: Channel disclaimer: does not promote drugs or alcohol, content is for education, follow community guidelines.
Namaste and welcome, thanks to viewers for joining.
Joke setup: Mangeram complains to his wife Mona that he never got love though he gave her flowers on Valentine's Day and every other day.
Punchline: she says flowers will fall on you only when you die.
Moral drawn from the joke: a man's flowers come only at his funeral, so a man has a fixed place and gets no love; this is a social remark, no chart rule.

hindi: प्रेम मिलेगा भाई स्त्री को क्योंकि भाई स्त्री को प्रेम मिलना स्वाभाविक है वह शुक्र ग्रह है
says: Love and affection come naturally to the woman, because she is the Venus principle; so Venus is treated as the karaka of being loved, in contrast to the male principle which he will tie to Mars.
ambiguity: Speaks of a woman and a man as social types; unclear whether he means Venus is the karaka of the female sex in a chart or of anyone who receives love.
classical_check: Classical texts make Venus karaka of wife, women and love; broadly agrees.

gist: A man has no identity until he finds a woman and is called a bachelor; social comment.

hindi: आज की क्लास हम कर रहे हैं मंगल ग्रह पर जिसके पास पुरुषार्थ है
says: Announces the topic of this class as Mars, and defines Mars as the planet that holds purusharth, meaning self-driven manly effort and exertion.
classical_check: Classical karakatva of Mars includes courage, energy, effort; agrees.

hindi: जो पुरुष होता है उसका कोई अर्थ होना चाहिए उसमें कुछ क्रिया होनी चाहिए
says: A male principle must have some purpose and visible action in it; he reads Mars as the factor of doing, not merely being.
classical_check: Silent on this wording; consistent with Mars as karaka of action.

hindi: भोली लड़की है गाय है ... लड़का भोला है गधा है जब तक वोह कुत्ता ना हो सांड ना हो उसकी कोई कदर नहीं
says: By analogy: an innocent girl is admired as a cow but an innocent boy is called a donkey; a male is valued only when he has dog or bull like bite, that is, Mars-like aggression and capacity to act.
ambiguity: A social analogy with a gender stereotype; the astrological content is only that a weak Mars means a person who is not respected.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: प्रोटेक्शन नहीं दे सकता तो वो व्यर्थ है उसका जीवन जीना बेकार है
says: A man who cannot give protection is useless; he ties protection of others to the Mars function, so Mars means the ability to guard family and dependants.
ambiguity: Harsh phrasing; he does not say which chart factor shows lack of protection.
classical_check: Mars as protector, soldier, defender in classical karakatva; agrees in spirit.

hindi: फालतू की भय भय कर रहा है तो भी कुत्ते की श्रेणी में यदि वह कार्य कर रहा है तो एक दमदार कुत्ते की श्रेणी में
says: Continuing the dog analogy: a man who only makes noise is a mere dog, one who actually works and acts is a strong dog; the distinction is between noise and real action, the latter being Mars.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब तक वह पुरुषार्थ नहीं करेगा कर्म नहीं करेगा तब तक उसका जीवन व्यर्थ है
says: Until a person does purusharth and karma, effort and action, life is wasted; he presents effort as the core duty tied to Mars.
classical_check: Philosophical; not a chart rule.

gist: Arjuna lost his drive for effort and Krishna told him to act; Mahabharata illustration.

hindi: सब लोग यही कहते हैं कि भाई हमें तो अच्छा रिजल्ट मिलना चाहिए पढ़ाई करनी है नंबर लाने हैं तो ... मेहनत करनी है
says: Everyone wants a good result such as exam marks, but marks need effort first; the action that produces the result is the work of Mars.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मेहनत करने के पश्चात ... रिजल्ट ठीक दे दियो प्रभु ... उम्मीद किससे करनी है खुद से
says: After working, people pray to God for the result, but expectation should be placed on oneself and not on the result or on God; self-reliance is the Mars attitude.
classical_check: Silent; philosophical.

hindi: इसलिए हम कहते हैं उम्मीद तसल्ली बता ना खुशी छोड़ दो
says: Advice to drop expectation, consolation and the chase for happiness from outside; caption is jumbled but the sense is detachment from hopes placed on others.
ambiguity: Words tasalli, bata na, khushi are garbled, exact items to give up uncertain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कौन सा पुरुष है जो यह पुरुषार्थ करेगा वह है मंगल
says: Names Mars as the planet that carries out purusharth; the chart factor for self-effort is Mars.
classical_check: Agrees with Mars as karaka of exertion.

hindi: हम स्वयं से उम्मीद करने में लगे हुए नहीं है हम दूसरे से उम्मीद कर रहे हैं घर गृहस्थ काम पैसा सब जगह यही जिंदगी बर्बाद है
says: We place our expectation on others in home, work and money instead of on ourselves, and this ruins life; he reads this misplacement as the failure of the Mars function.
ambiguity: No chart placement is named for this dependence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मेरा बेटा मुझे सुख दे मेरा भाई मुझे सुख दे
says: Examples of misplaced expectation: wanting a son or a brother to provide one's happiness; relatives and children are not the source of one's own security.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Arjuna trusts his own arrows and wins with Krishna, Duryodhana trusts Karna, Bhishma, Drona and loses.

hindi: स्वयं की ऊर्जा से धधक वाला सूर्य सदैव रोशनी देता है और मान पाता है
says: The Sun blazes by its own energy, always gives light and receives honour; self-luminous means self-reliant and respected.
classical_check: Sun as karaka of authority and self; agrees.

hindi: चंद्रमा सूर्य से ऊर्जा लेता है और कभी चमका कभी बुझ गया उसका मान सम्मान अमावास और पूर्ण माशी से होता है
says: The Moon takes its light from the Sun, so it shines then fades; its standing varies with the new moon and full moon, showing dependence on another source.
ambiguity: Wording of respect at amavasya and purnima is unclear; may mean its strength depends on phase.
classical_check: Classical Moon strength depends on paksha (waxing is strong), agrees broadly.

hindi: जो व्यक्ति स्वयं के ऊपर पूर्ण रूप से निर्भर रहता है और दूसरों को भाड़ में भेजता है उसका मंगल महाबली है
says: A person who relies wholly on himself and does not lean on others has a very strong Mars; self-reliance is how a strong Mars shows in behaviour.
ambiguity: Strong Mars here is behavioural; he does not give sign or house conditions.
classical_check: Silent on this wording.

hindi: आप भाड़ में भेजने के चक्र के ग्रह को आज समझ रहे हैं जिसमें आप अपने अलावा सबको भाड़ में भेजते हैं क्योंकि आपकी ऊर्जा आपके पास रहती है
says: Today we study the planet of the cycle where you send everyone but yourself packing, because your energy stays with you; Mars is the planet of keeping energy inward.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जन्म लेने के समय हमारे पास इतना नन्ही सी बॉडी होती है नाभी की नाल से मां के साथ प्लेसेंटा जुड़ा होता है
says: At birth we are a tiny body joined to the mother by the umbilical cord and placenta; he starts building the navel as the origin point of the body.
ambiguity: Biological description; astrological use comes later when he links navel to Mars.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हम शुरू में नाभी होते हैं हमारा शरीर नाभि मात्र होता है इस नाभि से हमारा जन्म का उद्गम हुआ
says: In the beginning the body is just the navel and our birth originates from it; the navel is the root centre of the body.
classical_check: Silent; Ayurveda and yoga treat nabhi as a root centre.

hindi: इस सेंटर से ऊपर की ओर उठ गए और इस सेंटर से हम नीचे की ओर आ गए शरीर नाभि से ऊपर और नीचे सेट होता है
says: From the navel centre the body grows upward and downward, so the body is organised as upper and lower halves around the navel.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इस नाभि के द्वारा ही हमारी स्वास चलती है
says: Breathing runs through the navel; he treats the navel as the seat of the life breath rather than the lungs.
ambiguity: Physiologically loose; yogic claim.
classical_check: Yogic texts place prana at navel and heart; partly agrees.

hindi: ऊपर स्पिरिट एनर्जी नीचे डेविल एनर्जी है
says: Above the navel is spirit energy and below it is devil energy; the body has a divine upper current and a base lower current meeting at the navel.
ambiguity: The word devil is his term; not a classical term.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह स्पिरिट एनर्जी काम कहां से करती है डेविल एनर्जी कहां से काम करती है वो नाभी से करती है
says: Both the spirit energy and the devil energy operate from the navel, so the navel is the control point for both currents.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नाभी जो है हमारी बली होनी चाहिए सब कहते हैं एक्सरसाइज करने वाले व्यक्ति से तुम्हारे कोर में स्ट्रेंथ है
says: The navel must be strong, as everyone tells an exerciser that the core must be strong; core strength is the physical sign of a healthy navel centre.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: रोलर कोस्टर में जाते हुए जैसे ही ऊपर से नीचे गिरता है नाभी अंदर चली जाती है नाभी डर जाती है जब हम खुश होते हैं नाभी बाहर आ जाती है
says: On a roller coaster drop the navel pulls in with fear and in happiness it comes out; he uses bodily sensation to show the navel reacts to emotion.
ambiguity: Everyday observation, not a chart rule.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नाभी ही सारा खेल खेल रही है और इस नाभि के द्वारा ही स्वास्थ की सारी प्रक्रियाएं आयुर्वेद में कराई जाती है
says: The navel runs the whole game and Ayurveda performs its health processes through the navel; so health therapy is routed through this centre.
ambiguity: Therapy claim only; no diagnosis stated.
classical_check: Ayurveda has nabhi chikitsa and nabhi as marma; partly agrees.

hindi: यहां हमारा प्राण वायु आता है प्राण वायु इसके नीचे हमारी अपान वायु होती है यहां हमारी उदान वायु होती है व्यान वायु सारे में घूमती है
says: Places the winds in the body: prana vayu in the upper region, apana below it, udana in the throat region and vyana moving through the whole body.
ambiguity: Locations are said by gesture, 'here', so exact body parts are guessed; samana vayu is not mentioned in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees that prana is chest, apana lower, udana throat, vyana all over.

hindi: यह पांच किस्म की वायु का निर्धारण हमारी नाभि से होता है और पूरे के पूरे अंतरिक्ष की जो नाभि है वो यह मंगल ग्रह पर निर्भर है
says: The five vayus are governed from the navel, and the navel of the entire cosmos depends on Mars, so Mars is the navel point of the solar system and of the body.
ambiguity: Cosmic navel claim is his own; no classical link of Mars to nabhi found.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link Mars to blood, marrow and energy rather than the navel.

hindi: मंगल यह सूर्य हो गया यहां सूर्य हो गया यह चंद्रमा इसके साथ धरती का लेते हैं यह बुध हो गया ... फिर यहां
says: He starts drawing the order of bodies from the Sun outward: Moon with the Earth, Mercury and so on, to show where Mars sits among them.
ambiguity: Garbled by gestures at a board; listing continues in the next chunk.
classical_check: Heliocentric order is astronomy, not a classical Jyotish rule.

hindi: फिर यह अर्थ आ गई धरती धरा वसुंधरा उसके पश्चात मंगल ग्रह आ गया फिर जुपिटर सैटर्न यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो
says: Order continues: Venus, Earth, then Mars, then Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto; Mars is the first planet outside the Earth and he calls this chain the working navel of space.
ambiguity: Venus is partly garbled in the caption; Uranus, Neptune, Pluto are listed by their English names.
classical_check: Outer planets are not in classical Jyotish.

hindi: इसे धरती का ट्विन ब्रदर कहा जाता है इसके पास पानी नहीं है मंगल आग का गोला कहते हैं मंगल अग्नि है
says: Mars is called Earth's twin brother but has no water; it is a ball of fire, so Mars is the fire element.
classical_check: Mars as fire element is classical; agrees.

hindi: चंद्रमा पानी होता है इसके पास चंद्रमा नहीं है इसलिए मंगल को चार नंबर चंद्रमा की राशि में नीच कहा जाता है
says: The Moon is water, and Mars has no moon, so Mars is called debilitated in sign number 4, the Moon's sign Cancer, where fire meets water.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Cancer is debilitated in every house; the lagna is sign 4 minus house plus 1. What changes is the house meaning of the weakened Mars and what it rules from that lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Lagna is Libra (4-10+1=-5, +12 = 7). Mars rules the 2nd and 7th for Libra and sits debilitated in the 10th; derived: work drive is damped by emotion, though Mars gets directional strength in the 10th, so classical reading is mixed.
Lagna is Aries (4-4+1=1). Mars rules the 1st and 8th and sits debilitated in the 4th; derived: the self-energy is dampened at home and in peace of mind.
Lagna is Capricorn (4-7+1=-2, +12 = 10). Mars rules the 4th and 11th and is debilitated in the 7th; derived: gains and comforts come through partners, but the fire in partnership is weakened.

ambiguity: Sign number 4 is Cancer here, matching Aries=1.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is debilitated in Cancer.

hindi: कि सबसे गंदा बिहेवियर करता है आप आग में पानी और पानी में आग नहीं डाल सकते
says: Mars in the water sign behaves at its worst, since you cannot put water into fire or fire into water; the fire and water conflict explains the debilitation.
ambiguity: Also may apply to other water signs, he only says Cancer here.
classical_check: Classical reason for debilitation is not given this way; his explanation is original.

hindi: घर के सदन एरिया के अंदर अग्नि का इलाका होता है साउथ ईस्ट और नॉर्थ ईस्ट बेल्ट जो होती है वहां पर पानी कन्वर्ट होता है स्पेस से
says: In a house, the south-east is the fire zone, and the north-east belt is where water is drawn in from space; fire and water zones are kept in different corners.
ambiguity: 'Sadan area' is garbled; he says south-east as fire and north-east as water.
classical_check: Vastu agrees: south-east is Agni corner, north-east is Ishan with water.

hindi: इस जगह पर रसोई हो जाने मातय शरीर में कई किस्म की व्याधियों हो जाती है नुकसान हो जाता है
says: If the kitchen sits in the water corner, the body suffers various ailments and there are losses; a vastu placement claim linking Mars fire to the right corner.
ambiguity: Caption says 'this place' so it likely means the north-east; recorded as a tradition claim, not a medical statement.
classical_check: Vastu texts warn against a kitchen in the north-east; agrees.

gist: Sentence breaks off at 'so your navel...' and continues in the next batch.

hindi: एरिया नाभि पर ही रहना चाहिए नाभि डिस्प्लेस ना हो यह आपका मंगल ग्रह है
says: The centre of balance should stay at the navel and the navel must not get displaced; he calls this navel centre your Mars, so Mars is the navel point of the person.
ambiguity: The first word is cut from the previous chunk; 'area' likely means the body centre.
classical_check: Silent; classical Mars is not tied to the navel.

hindi: आज हम मंगल की ही क्लास कर रहे हैं इसके लिए बहुत सुंदर शब्द आता है मंगल भवन अमंगल हारी
says: Repeats that the class is on Mars and quotes the Ramayana line mangal bhavan amangal hari, a play on the name Mangal meaning auspicious and remover of inauspicious things.
ambiguity: The phrase in the verse refers to Ram; he uses it as wordplay for Mars.
classical_check: Verse is from the Ramcharitmanas; the link to the planet is his own.

hindi: आपके पेट में गड़बड़ होती है तो सारी बीमारी होती है आपकी कुंडली में मंगल ग्रह का सत्यानाश है तो आपकी जिंदगी में पेट का नरक है
says: If the stomach is disturbed all illness follows, and if Mars is ruined in the chart, the stomach area becomes a trouble spot in life; tradition claim linking an afflicted Mars to digestive trouble, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: He does not define what makes Mars ruined (sign, house or aspect).
classical_check: Classical medical astrology links the Sun and Mars with pitta and digestion; broadly agrees.

hindi: इसका मतलब आपका मंगल खराब है यानी नाभिक खिसकी सीधी सी बात पेट खराब आपका हाजमा ही गया
says: A weak Mars means the navel centre has slipped, which shows as a bad stomach and lost digestion; weak Mars equals poor digestive fire.
classical_check: Silent on the navel-slip idea.

hindi: डॉक्टर कहता है भूखे रहो कुछ मत खिलाओ इसको हील होने दो अपने आप ... सुला दो पट्ठे को कोई कार्य नहीं करना
says: A doctor treating a stomach upset tells you to fast and rest and let the body heal by itself; he uses this to show the body's self-healing is done by Mars once other work stops.
ambiguity: Medical advice is only an illustration; no medical recommendation is being made.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: बॉडी खुद को हील करेगी कैसे करेगी जब आपका मंगल अपने आप सही चलेगा मंगल सब कुछ हीलिंग करता है
says: The body heals itself when Mars is working properly; Mars is the healing power.
classical_check: Classical Mars is karaka of surgeons and vitality, not generic healing; partly differs.

hindi: मंगल ही डॉक्टर बनाता है कुंडली के अंदर मंगल के पास ही फार्मेसी है
says: Mars makes people doctors and holds the pharmacy in a chart, so medicine and pharmacy professions belong to Mars.
classical_check: Classical texts give doctors and surgeons to Mars, also Sun and Jupiter; pharmacy is an extension.

hindi: जितने फार्मेसिस्ट की लॉबी है ना वर्ल्ड के अंदर सबसे ऊंची ... वॉर के बाद वॉर से सेकंड इंडस्ट्री फार्मा है उनके पास मंगल की शक्ति हो
says: The pharma lobby is the strongest in the world; after war, pharma is the second largest industry, and both sit under Mars power, so he links arms and drug industries to Mars.
ambiguity: Industry ranking is his claim, not verified.
classical_check: Weapons and war are classical Mars; pharma is his extension.

gist: Repeats the Arjuna line: one who trusts his own strength wins, one who shines by his own energy.

hindi: सूर्य शक्ति देता है स्वयं नाभि पर काम करता है
says: The Sun gives strength and works on its own through the navel region; the navel centre is the Sun-Mars power point.
ambiguity: Unclear whether the Sun is the subject here or whether he is still on Mars.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Percentages of fire, water and earth element near the navel are garbled in the caption (4, 72, 12 and 'C cube speed').

hindi: हृदय चक्र से यह इलेक्ट्रोमैग्नेटिक सिग्नल फेंकता है
says: The heart centre throws electromagnetic signals out; the heart acts as a transmitter while the navel acts as the power source.
ambiguity: Subject of 'it' is unclear, may be the heart chakra or the navel.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यदि आपकी कुंडली में मंगल अच्छा है तो आप पुरुषार्थी हो ... सुस्त है उठा जाता बैठा नहीं जाता कौन काम करे मंदिर जा रहे हैं भीख मांग रहे हे भगवान तू दे दे
says: With a good Mars in the chart you are a doer; with a bad Mars you lie around lazy, will not work, go to the temple and beg God to give.

hindi: अशुभ मंगल आपका कौन मित्र है आपकी नाभी आपका मित्र है आपके जीवन के अंदर नाभी क्या करती है साथ देती है
says: Asks who your friend is when Mars is weak and answers that your navel is your friend, since it supports you throughout life.
classical_check: Silent; Mars as karaka of friends is not classical (Mercury and Venus are).

hindi: अंतिम समय मर गए खत्म साथ किसने छोड़ा आपके अंदर जो आत्मा वास कर रही है जो शरीर को चला रही है वह कहां से ऑपरेट कर रही है नाभी से

hindi: जठराग्नि कहते हैं कुछ भी ना खिला दो आग लगा देता है ... वेज नॉनवेज तीखा कड़वा लोहा मिट्टी कंकड़ सब आग के हवाले जठराग्नि इतना भयंकर हाइड्रोक्लोरिक एसिड है

hindi: ब्लेड खा लो जला के खत्म यह अग्नि है यहां और अग्नि का मालिक कौन हुआ हनुमान हनुमान की कॉन्शसनेस नाभि से चलती है

hindi: ब्रह्मचारी इसका कोई लिंग नहीं है केवल लिंग भेद की बात करें हनुमान क्या है पुरुष पुरुषार्थ करने वाले मंगल पुरुष ग्रह है

hindi: मरती हुई शैया पर पड़े व्यक्ति की भी जबान चल रही होती है नीचे से जीवन गया पैर से फिर घुटने से गया फिर हिप बोन से गया फिर पड़ गए बिस्तर पे

hindi: अपना मंगल पावरफुल करने का अर्थ क्या है कुंडली में कहीं भी बैठा है वो वहां के अच्छे फल देगा

hindi: मंगल सेट हो जाएगा आपकी कुंडली में जहां भी बैठा है उस चीज से मित्रता करा देगा शत्रु स्थान में बैठ गया शत्रु आपका मित्र बनेगा भाग्य स्थान में बैठ गया भाग्य मित्र बनेगा

says: The child is full of energy and hops about so much that parents complain he will drive them mad; Mars is restless physical energy.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is energy and restlessness.

gist: Girls are made to sit quietly with good manners from the start while boys are ill-mannered and make noise; a social stereotype.

hindi: क्योंकि ऊर्जा का केंद्र यह पुरुष तत्व है
says: The centre of energy is the male element; he places the energetic, active principle in the purusha tattva that Mars represents.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Men were given a muscular body and women a muscular brain, so women can overpower men; women ask for equal rights but the two are not the same; a long social digression.
A full debate on this could be held but today's topic is not that.

hindi: मंगल आपका छोटा बालक है छोटे बालक की तरह यदि आपका स्वभाव है आप निडर हो आपको माइक मिल गया बोल सकते हो आपका मंगल सेट है
says: Mars is the small boy in you, and if your nature is like a child's, fearless and able to speak whenever you get a mic, your Mars is well set.
classical_check: Agrees that strong Mars gives courage and boldness in speech.

hindi: कुंडली में जहां भी मंगल बैठा होगा वह शुभता ही देगा
says: Wherever Mars sits in the chart, if it is set right it will only give auspicious results of that place.
cells_derived_method: The house sets which department of life benefits; the sign sets how comfortable Mars is there.

derived_examples.reading: Lagna is Aquarius (1-3+1=-1, +12 = 11). Mars rules the 3rd and 10th in its own sign in the 3rd; derived: courage and effort bring career success.
Lagna is Capricorn (8-11+1=-2, +12 = 10). Mars rules the 4th and 11th in its own sign in the 11th; derived: gains through property and large networks.
Lagna is Virgo (10-5+1=6). Mars is exalted in the 5th and rules the 3rd and 8th; derived: bold intellect, strong effort for children and studies.

ambiguity: 'Set' is not defined; read as strong or well-placed.
classical_check: Agrees in general; classical texts still warn of dusthana lordships.

hindi: नीच का मंगल कुंडली के अंदर हो बर्बाद कर देता है
says: A debilitated Mars in the chart ruins things; Mars in Cancer is the damaging case.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Cancer is debilitated in every house; the house shows which area is ruined, and the lagna decides what Mars rules.

derived_examples.reading: Lagna is Cancer (4-1+1=4). Mars rules the 5th and 10th and is debilitated in the 1st; derived: energy and status are lowered at first but the lagna lord Moon can help.
Lagna is Sagittarius (4-8+1=-3, +12 = 9). Mars rules the 5th and 12th and is debilitated in the 8th; derived: sudden setbacks, hidden matters, stress on children's matters.

ambiguity: He does not say 'Cancer' in this sentence; it is inferred from the earlier line that Mars is debilitated in sign number 4.
classical_check: Agrees that debilitated Mars is weak; classical texts allow cancellation (neecha bhanga).

hindi: नीच का मंगल दूसरे घर में धन स्थान में हो तो अरबपति भी बनाता है लेकिन आप हो कौन से वाले मंगल
says: A debilitated Mars in the 2nd house, the wealth house, can even make you a billionaire, which is a surprising claim; but he asks which kind of Mars you are.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Cancer in the 2nd means the lagna is Gemini (4-2+1=3); from there Mars rules the 6th and 11th, so the wealth claim rests on the 11th lordship. Other houses would give different areas.

derived_examples.reading: Lagna is Gemini (4-2+1=3). Mars rules the 6th (Scorpio) and 11th (Aries) and sits debilitated in the 2nd; derived: wealth and family wealth through gains lord, but with fluctuation.
Lagna is Virgo (4-11+1=-6, +12 = 6). Mars rules the 3rd and 8th and is debilitated in the 11th; derived: gains come with delay and odd sources.

ambiguity: Claim of a billionaire from a debilitated Mars is stated loosely; no neecha bhanga condition is given.
classical_check: Differs: classical wealth rules rely on 2nd and 11th lords and Jupiter; neecha Mars alone is not a wealth yoga.

hindi: अंधा पैसा दे सकता है नीच का मंगल है यार खराब कर रहा है कमाल है कैसी विचित्र बात है ऐसे थोड़ी होता है
says: He says a debilitated Mars can give 'blind money', unearned wealth, though it also spoils things, and calls this strange; the claim is contradictory and not explained.
ambiguity: He seems to mock the idea himself; unclear whether he accepts it for Mars.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नीच का बुद्ध आपको अंधा पैसा देता है कुछ भी किए बिना आपको अमीर बनाएगा और अगर करने लग गए तो पैसा नहीं देगा
says: A debilitated Mercury, Mercury in Pisces, gives blind money and makes you rich without doing anything, but stops giving money if you start working; his claim, not investment advice.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Pisces is debilitated in any house; the house names the area where money comes effortlessly, and the lagna decides which houses Mercury rules.

derived_examples.reading: Lagna is Aquarius (12-2+1=11). Mercury rules the 5th and 8th and is debilitated in the 2nd; derived: money via family, speculation or inheritance without effort.
Lagna is Sagittarius (12-4+1=9). Mercury rules the 7th and 10th and is debilitated in the 4th; derived: money from property or the mother's side comes without effort, work income suffers.
Lagna is Gemini (12-10+1=3). Mercury rules the 1st and 4th and is debilitated in the 10th; derived: career is unusual and income comes unearned while earnest work yields little.

ambiguity: He wrote Mercury where the previous lines said Mars; Mercury in Pisces is debilitated, which fits the sign logic.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat debilitated Mercury as weak in intellect and trade, not as a source of effortless wealth.

gist: He does not know the logic for effortless wealth from a debilitated Mercury and will take it up in the Mercury class.

hindi: यह मंगल क्या करता है य यह आपकी अग्नि को प्रज्वलित करके सही चलाता है आपको बुढ़ापा नहीं आने देगा आप युवा लगोगे
says: Mars keeps your inner fire lit and running properly; it will not let old age come, so you look young; strong Mars is a youthful look and vitality.
classical_check: Silent; classically youthful looks are Mercury and Moon.

hindi: बुद्ध होगा तो बालक लगोगे एज से छोटे लगते हैं ऐसे लोग और मंगल होगा तो आपका शरीर शेप बहुत होगा बहुत जान होगी शरीर में
says: With Mercury strong you look like a child and younger than your age, while with Mars the body is well shaped and full of strength.
classical_check: Agrees: Mercury gives a youthful face.

hindi: अगर आपका मंगल खराब है आपको नॉनवेज सूट नहीं करेगा सारा रेड मीट इसके पास है लाल मास
says: If Mars is bad, non-vegetarian food will not suit you, and all red meat belongs to Mars; red meat is the Mars food.
ambiguity: A dietary claim, not medical advice.
classical_check: Agrees that meat and red foods are Mars; the 'does not suit' claim is his own.

hindi: अगर आपका मंगल अच्छा है तो लाल मास से आपको नुकसान नहीं होगा ... जिनका ग्रह जैसा है वैसा पच जाता है
says: With a good Mars red meat does you no harm; people digest food according to their planet; this resolves the world debate over eating meat.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जिनकी बॉडी के अंदर मंगल का दोष है रेड वाइन पीने से भी उनकी बॉडी में यूरिक एसिड बढ़ेगा और हड्डियों के जोड़ में दर्द देगा
says: For people with a Mars defect, even red wine raises uric acid and causes joint pain; a tradition claim on food and body, not a medical diagnosis.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे लोगों को रेड वाइन भी नहीं पीनी वाइट वाइन पी सकते हैं रेड वाइन का चक्कर है रेड मीट नहीं खाते स्पेशली कहा जाता है मटन ना खाए
says: Such people should avoid red wine, though white is fine, and should avoid red meat, especially mutton; a do-and-don't for a Mars defect, recorded as his tradition claim.
ambiguity: Contradicts his earlier remark that the navel fire cares nothing about what you eat.
classical_check: Differs from classical advice, which would limit meat on Tuesdays rather than red wine.

hindi: उन दिनों का दोष हो जाएगा ग्रेवी लिक्विड में आता है सारा
says: Eating such food brings the defect of those days, and gravy counts under liquids; the caption is garbled but he is adding gravy to the avoid list.
ambiguity: 'Those days' may refer to a particular day or period; unclear.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Don't make your mouth water, we are closing this topic; non-veg lovers must be enjoying it.

hindi: आठ वर्ष के बालक को कैसी मिलती है चीज पापा ले आते हैं मम्मी दे देती है आपको भगवान कृपा करके देगा आप हनुमान है आपको राम कृपा करके देंगे आपको माता सीता मिलेंगी
says: An eight-year-old gets things because father brings and mother gives; as the Mars child you will receive by grace, as Hanuman receives from Ram, even Mother Sita; Mars person is supplied by higher forces.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब सिर पर राम का हाथ होगा क्या कमी रही राम क्या है हृदय कॉन्शसनेस इसको हमें समझना पड़ेगा
says: With Ram's hand on the head there is no lack; Ram is the heart consciousness, which we must understand; the heart is the source of the support the Mars child needs.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पहले की क्लास में हमने किया यह हार्ट चक्र है यह 12 पेटल होते हैं हमारे यह नाभी केंद्र 10 पेटल होते हैं
says: As covered in an earlier class, the heart chakra has 12 petals and the navel centre has 10 petals; he links the navel centre to the number 10.
classical_check: Agrees: Anahata has 12 petals and Manipura has 10.

hindi: यह हनुमान है 10 नंबर हनुमान का है 10 नंबर इसलिए क्योंकि राशि नंबर 10 शनि की है
says: Hanuman has the number 10 because sign number 10, Capricorn, belongs to Saturn; he ties Hanuman, the navel's 10 petals and Capricorn together through the number.
ambiguity: Number 10 is read as sign Capricorn on the Aries=1 count.
classical_check: Agrees that Capricorn is Saturn's sign; the Hanuman number link is his own.

hindi: शनि की ही राशि में 10 नंबर में जब यह आता है तो श्रवण नक्षत्र में उच्च का हो जाता है
says: When Mars comes into sign number 10, Saturn's own sign Capricorn, it becomes exalted, and he says this happens in the Shravana nakshatra.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Capricorn is exalted in any house, with exaltation fully peaking at 28 degrees; the house gives the area and the lagna gives the lordships.

derived_examples.reading: Lagna is Aries (10-10+1=1). Mars rules the 1st and 8th and is exalted in the 10th; derived: strong career, authority and a daring nature.
Lagna is Libra (10-4+1=7). Mars rules the 2nd and 7th and is exalted in the 4th; derived: strong property and home gains, a forceful home life.
Lagna is Gemini (10-8+1=3). Mars rules the 6th and 11th and is exalted in the 8th; derived: resilience in crises, gains through hidden matters.

ambiguity: He names Shravana; the caption ends the sentence with 'who is Saturn' for the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees on exaltation in Capricorn but differs on the nakshatra: Mars peaks at 28 degrees Capricorn in Dhanishta, and Shravana is Moon's nakshatra.

hindi: शनि कौन है नौकर चाकर सारे काम करने वाला सेवक यह सेवक के घर जब जाता है
says: Saturn is the servant who does all the work, and Mars is the one who goes to the servant's house; Saturn karaka is service and labour.
ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of the last chunk.
classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is servants and labourers.

hindi: अब सेनापति जाएगा सबसे छोटे कांस्टेबल के पास ... वो क्या करेगा साहब बैठिए सबसे ऊंचा आसन देगा आप जो मर्जी करें
says: When the commander visits the lowest constable or orderly, he is given the highest seat and told to do as he wishes; Mars is honoured in the house of Saturn, which explains the exaltation in Capricorn.
cells_derived_method: Mars gets honour in the Saturn signs; the house sets the area where honour and freedom show.

derived_examples.reading: Lagna is Virgo (10-5+1=6). Mars rules the 3rd and 8th and is exalted in the 5th; derived: honour and freedom in studies, speculation and children.
Lagna is Gemini (11-9+1=3). Mars rules the 6th and 11th and sits in Saturn's sign in the 9th; derived: obedient support for luck, father and dharma.

ambiguity: He speaks of Saturn's house, without separating Capricorn from Aquarius.
classical_check: Agrees with the exaltation in Capricorn; the servant analogy is his own.

hindi: शनि पेट्रोल माना जाता है धरती के गर्भ में छुपा हुआ सारा का सारा पेट्रोल
says: Saturn is regarded as petrol, all the petrol hidden in the womb of the earth; underground oil is a Saturn significance.
classical_check: Agrees: oil and minerals are Saturn.

hindi: मंगल क्या आग सोना कहां निकलता है धरती के नीचे एलुमिनियम तांबा कहां निकलता है धरती के नीचे
says: Mars is fire, and gold, aluminium and copper all come from under the earth; metals mined from the ground are in the Mars and Saturn domain.
ambiguity: Unclear whether the metals are given to Mars or only used to describe Saturn's underground wealth.
classical_check: Copper is Mars classically, gold is Sun and Jupiter; aluminium is not classical.

hindi: कैसे सेट करते हैं आग भट्टी में डालते हैं मंगल उसको शेपिंग करता है मंगल आपके जीवन को शेप करके देगा आपका शनि
says: Metal is set by putting it in the furnace, where Mars shapes it, and in the same way Mars will shape your life out of what Saturn provides.
classical_check: Silent; Mars as furnace and metalwork is classical.

hindi: शनि के पास क्या सारा का सारी लक्ष्मी और सारी लक्ष्मी प्राप्त कैसे होती है शनि के द्वारा
says: Saturn holds all of Lakshmi, wealth, and all wealth is obtained through Saturn; Saturn is the channel of wealth.
classical_check: Differs: classical wealth is Jupiter and Venus; Saturn gives wealth through hard work.

hindi: अगर मंगल को हटा दे कुछ भी किए बिना कम से कम मेहनत करो दो तरीके देख लो शनि कुंडली बढ़िया है आराम से कम से कम मेहनत करो आलसी टाइप रहो ना नियम से चलो ना डिसिप्लिन बनाओ अगर खूब
says: Two ways: without Mars you work minimally, stay lazy and keep no discipline; if a lot still comes to you with that attitude, it shows your Saturn is strong; Saturn can pay even without effort in a good chart.
ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next chunk and is hard to parse.
classical_check: Differs: classical Saturn gives results only after hard work and delay.

hindi: मिल रहा है शनि की ताकत है नहीं तो उपाय करो इसके अगर नहीं हो रहा है और आपके अंदर प्रोक्रेस्टिनेशन है यार तो हिलता ही नहीं
says: If plenty comes without effort it is Saturn's strength; if it does not and you procrastinate and do not move, then do a remedy for it; the remedy is for lazy Mars and weak Saturn.
ambiguity: The remedy is not named.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो अर्जुन बन गया है अस्त्र शस्त्र छोड़ दिए भाई तो पुरुषार्थ
says: Such a procrastinator is like Arjuna who dropped his weapons, so he must take up purusharth again; use of the Arjuna story to urge action.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पुरुषार्थ करें स्त्री के लिए शब्द नहीं कहा गया पुरुषार्थ क्योंकि स्त्री स्वयं शक्ति है ऐसा ना सोचे कि पुरुष पुरुषार्थ पुरुष शब्द क्यों है
says: The word purusharth is not used for women because woman is herself shakti; he explains why the word contains purusha without meaning it is only for men.
ambiguity: A linguistic and philosophical remark.
classical_check: Silent; purushartha in the four goals applies to all.

hindi: पुरुष वो एनर्जी है जो पड़ी हुई है उसकी मूविंग एनर्जी को हम स्त्री तत्त्व कहते हैं फेमिनिन पुरुष और स्त्री कोई अलग नहीं है यह पैसिव और एक्टिव एनर्जी का खेल है
says: Purusha is the energy that lies still, and its moving energy is the feminine element; man and woman are not separate but the play of passive and active energy.
ambiguity: This is a Samkhya-style idea, with Purusha passive and Prakriti active.
classical_check: Agrees with the Samkhya view.

hindi: यह पुरुषार्थ शक्ति ऑन कर दी तो शक्ति ऑन करना मींस मंगल एक्टिव हो गया आपका शनि भी पानी भरेगा
says: When the purusharth power is switched on, meaning Mars becomes active, even your Saturn will serve you and fetch water; an active Mars makes Saturn work for you.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसके आगे शनि का दूसरा भाई कौन है यमराज यम यमराज की राशि क्या है 11 नंबर
says: Saturn's other brother is Yamraj, and Yamraj's sign is number 11, Aquarius; in his scheme Yama is the ruler of Aquarius alongside Saturn.

classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Aquarius only to Saturn; Pluto is a modern planet.

hindi: 11 नंबर राशि में जब मंगल होता है यह यमराज यहां ले आए मरता भी नहीं आदमी और टशन में मरता है
says: When Mars is in sign number 11, Aquarius, the person is said to live on and eventually pass away in style; this is his claim on stylish endurance; no timing of death is given.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Aquarius in any house; the house shows where the toughness shows, the lagna sets the lordships of Mars.

Lagna is Pisces (11-12+1=0, +12 = 12). Mars rules the 2nd and 9th and sits in the 12th in Aquarius; derived: hardiness while spending and living abroad.

ambiguity: 'Does not die' is hyperbole; not a longevity statement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: दांत पूरे होते हैं उसके क्योंकि मंगल दात है चट्टान

ambiguity: The word 'rock' at the start of the next chunk is read as the end of this sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: teeth are Mars in many texts.

hindi: आप मंगल ग्रह की देखेंगे तो लाल मंगल ग्रह है चट्टान ही है वहां एन चट्टान के जैसा बंदा रहेगा
says: Looking at the planet Mars you see a red world of rock, and a person with strong Mars is like a rock; solid, firm and unmoved.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हनुमान की शक्ति दिखाता ना ये बिग साइज हनुमान है क्या ताकत है तो महावीर दो ही महावीर है एक तो है हनुमान और दूसरे हैं बिल्कुल शांत महावीर भगवान

says: Two forms, one hot and one cool, are both Mahavir, so heroic that even naked you would be called God and could do all things yourself; Mars heroism means self-sufficiency.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: महावीर वीरता का सूचक मंगल है और शनि की राशि में महावीर इसके नक्षत्र की योनि है वानर बंदर की शक्ल बना रखी है

hindi: इसलिए कल्पना बना दी गई कि यह वानर की जैसे शकल वाला है इसकी पूजा के लिए इसके प्रणाम करने के लिए वानर की सेवा की जाती है
says: Because of this a vanara-faced form was imagined, and for worship and homage to him, service of monkeys is done; serving monkeys is a way of honouring Hanuman.

says: Coral on Saturn's finger is meant for the case where the trouble sits in sign number 1 (Aries), Mars's own fiery sign; the Saturn finger is used to ground that Mars energy.
cells_derived_method: Applies to any house where Aries falls. Aries in the 1st gives a self, body and temper problem; Aries in the 5th a children, mind and intuition problem; Aries in the 10th a career and authority problem.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the Aries lagna native's body, temper and drive are the area of trouble that coral is trying to settle.
Derived: for a chart whose 5th falls in Aries (Sagittarius lagna), the trouble shows up in children, learning and decisions.
Derived: for a chart whose 10th falls in Aries (Cancer lagna), the trouble shows up in work and status.

ambiguity: Sign number 1 is read as Aries (confirmed numbering in this series); could also mean house 1.
classical_check: Silent on linking Saturn's finger with Aries trouble; this is his own method.

hindi: मंगल के पास एक और आठ नंबर राशि दोनों है
says: Mars owns both sign 1 (Aries) and sign 8 (Scorpio).
cells_derived_method: Mars's meaning in a chart depends on the houses these two signs fall in. Aries lord and Scorpio lord are the same planet, so one placement carries both topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, Mars rules houses 1 and 8, so self and sudden change are tied together.
Derived: Cancer lagna (Scorpio in 5th), Mars rules the 5th and 10th, a yogakaraka for intellect and career.
Derived: Aquarius lagna (Aries in 3rd), Mars rules the 3rd and 10th, courage and career are linked.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars is lord of Aries and Scorpio.

hindi: एक आठ यह मंगल हो गया हमारा यहां पर हमारा हो गया क्या हो गया इंद्र
says: In his scheme sign 1 is Mars alone, while sign 8 is the sign where Mars is joined by Indra (Uranus), who takes the second lordship of Scorpio.
cells_derived_method: Scorpio in any house carries two lords, Mars and Uranus; the house topic is read through both. Aries stays pure Mars.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, Scorpio is the 8th, so Mars plus Uranus shape sudden events and hidden matters.
Derived: Scorpio lagna, self is run by Mars and Uranus, a restless, sharp, shock-prone personality.

ambiguity: Caption is rough; reading is that sign 8 belongs to Mars and also Indra.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Scorpio to Mars only; Uranus lordship is a modern, not a classical, idea.

hindi: आपने पता है हनुमान जी के पास क्या है गधा
says: He ties Mars to Hanuman and asks what Hanuman carries, the mace (caption wrote gadha, meaning gada), a symbol of Mars's raw strength.
ambiguity: Caption word is a spelling error; mace (gada) is meant.
classical_check: Hanuman as Mars's deity is common folk practice, not in Parashara.

hindi: कैसा प्रहार करती है वज्र सा वज्र किसके पास है इंद्र के पास
says: Indra holds the vajra, the thunderbolt that strikes like a hammer blow, so the Indra planet (Uranus) is the one that strikes suddenly.
classical_check: Indra's vajra is classical myth; Uranus as Indra is his own scheme.

hindi: कौन है थॉर थोर नाम का देवता है ग्रीक साहित्य में उसके पास क्या शक्ति है बिजली की शक्ति
says: He compares Indra to Thor, a god of lightning whose power is electricity, to explain Uranus's nature as sudden electrical force.
ambiguity: He calls Thor Greek; Thor is Norse (Zeus is the Greek lightning god).
classical_check: Factual slip: Thor is Norse; Zeus fits Greek. Jyotish texts are silent on this comparison.

hindi: बिजली कहां कड़कती है सारी बिजली कड़कती है आग लगा देती है नष्ट करती है पता नहीं कितने हजारों वोल्ट का करंट आकाश से आता है और कहां जाता है इसको कौन कंट्रोल कर सकता है समुद्र
says: Lightning burns and destroys with thousands of volts and no one can control it except the ocean, which absorbs it, so the ocean god is the controller of Indra's force.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own symbolism.

hindi: वरुण देवता है यह वरुण का स्थान है वरुण बिजली को काबू करना वरुण का ही बस्का है देवताओं का देवता सबका देव वरुण है
says: Varuna (Neptune), the god of gods, is the only one able to tame Indra's lightning, so Neptune sits as the controller or sink for Uranus's shock energy.
classical_check: Vedic Varuna is a water god; mapping him to Neptune is a modern link, silent in classical texts.

hindi: सारी बिजली कड़क के उसमें जाती है बिजली का काम आग भी और बिजली भी है तो सारी वोल्टेज यहां बनती है
says: Fire and electricity both belong to this energy, and the body's voltage is generated at the navel and stomach area, which he points to with a gesture.
cells_derived_method: Possibly Scorpio (sign 8) area symbolism, the belly and navel region. House dependence is not stated.
ambiguity: The word here is a pointing gesture; he does not say whether it is sign 8 or the navel only.
classical_check: Classical Kalapurusha gives Scorpio the lower belly and genitals; the navel link is his own.

hindi: आपके पेट में गड़बड़ होए ना तो इसका मतलब आपकी खोपड़ी खराब है आपके पेट की भूख मर जाती है दिमाग खराब हो रखा
says: He claims that stomach trouble and loss of appetite point to a disturbed mind, a gut-head link in this energy system. This is a health claim, recorded as his statement only, not a diagnosis.
ambiguity: Joking tone, so it is partly a figure of speech.
classical_check: Silent in the classics; this is his own claim and no medical advice.

gist: Rhetorical questions asking where the electricity went and gesturing at the body.

hindi: आपका यह हिस्सा सुन्न हो रहा है बिजली नहीं जा रही यह करंट नहीं जा रहा ना ऊर्जा
says: When a body part goes numb he reads it as the current or energy not reaching that part. This is his symbolic view, not a medical diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent; not a classical astrology statement and no medical value is claimed.

hindi: शरीर जो है सूक्ष्म शरीर जो है वह नाभि से चलता है एस्ट्रल बॉडी कहते हैं इसे
says: The subtle body, which he calls the astral body, works from the navel as its seat.
classical_check: Yogic anatomy places the pranic seat at the navel (manipura); not a Parashara point.

hindi: एस्ट्रल वर्ल्ड हमारी पितरों की है जो हमारे एस्ट्रल बॉडी है वह नाभी से निकलती है और यही रातों को घूमती है इधर उधर सपने नहीं देखते हम
says: The astral world is the realm of our ancestors, and our astral body leaves from the navel at night and wanders there, which is what we experience as dreams.
classical_check: Silent in astrology texts; a general occult belief.

hindi: अगर आपका मंगल ठीक बैठ गया मंगल की ट्रीटमेंट हो गई तो इंद्र देवता सेट रहते हैं
says: If Mars is well placed or its remedy is done, Indra (Uranus) also stays settled, since the two share sign 8.
cells_derived_method: Mars's strength and Uranus's behaviour move together. In a house where Scorpio falls, a fixed Mars helps that house's affairs run smoothly.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio lagna with Mars in its own sign in the 1st; a treated Mars here keeps the Uranus-like restlessness of the self in check.
Derived: Cancer lagna with Mars in Aries in the 10th; a well-placed Mars gives steady career and the sudden Uranus-type breaks stay mild.

ambiguity: Remedy details not given.
classical_check: Silent on Uranus; the Mars-first principle is only his own.

hindi: इंद्र के पास क्या है पार्टी बस मंगल के पास क्या है बिल्कुल कुछ नहीं पर पार्टी के लिए मंगल की आठ नंबर राशि इंद्र देवता के पास है
says: Indra's nature is party and enjoyment while Mars has no such taste, but sign 8 of Mars is given to Indra, so Scorpio carries the party and pleasure side.
cells_derived_method: Scorpio's pleasure and indulgence side is read through Uranus in the house where it falls.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna has Scorpio as 8th, pleasure through sudden or secret ways.
Derived: Cancer lagna has Scorpio as the 5th, so a party and romance side to creativity.

classical_check: Differs: classical Scorpio is only Mars's; Venus-style pleasure comes from Venus.

hindi: इंद्र ने घमासान पार्टी मचा रखी है जितना मंगल एक्सट्रीम हो गया हनुमान पूर्ण सेलिबेसी चरणों में इंद्र सिंहासन पर बैठा सोमरस ऐश अयाशी और वज्र और डरपोक है
says: The two ends of the Mars pair are opposite extremes: Hanuman is pure celibacy and service, while Indra sits on a throne with wine, luxury and indulgence, yet is also a great coward who lives in fear.
ambiguity: Whether this extreme split appears in one chart or across charts is not said.
classical_check: Silent; mythological symbolism is his own.

hindi: एक नाभी बाहर गई हुंकार भरी एक नाभी अंदर डर गए भाई माफ कर दो एक इंद्र
says: With the navel pushed out you roar (Mars-like aggression), with the navel drawn in you are afraid and plead for mercy (Indra-like fear). This is a body-sign claim, not medical.
ambiguity: Gesture-based explanation, hard to follow from caption.
classical_check: Silent in the classics.

hindi: हो गया और एक हो गया हनुमान और दोनों के पास क्या है अग्नि
says: So sign 1 is Hanuman (Mars) and sign 8 is Indra, and both have fire as their element.
cells_derived_method: Fire here is the energy type; in a house, it means heat and force on that house's topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: the 1st house gets a direct, impulsive fire.
Derived: Scorpio as the 8th house in Aries lagna means a hidden, intense fire.

ambiguity: Scorpio is a water sign classically; he calls it fire in the sense of Mars's fire, not element.
classical_check: Differs: Scorpio is a water sign classically; only Aries is fire.

hindi: तो इंद्र जब बचाने पर आता है तो बोल्ट ऑफ थंडर बोल्ट कहते हैं इसे हम आप बिजली की तरह काम करता है
says: When Indra comes to protect, he acts like a bolt of thunder, quick and electric, so Uranus helps by sudden rescue.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपकी बिजली कब काम करेगी जब नाभी को सब कुछ खाने को भी दोगे तो मंगल को सपोर्ट करेगा
says: Your electricity works when the navel is kept supported and fed, and then it supports Mars. The caption is broken and the meaning is a best guess.
ambiguity: Garbled caption; unclear what is given to the navel.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He defers the full class on Indra to some future time, if God permits.

hindi: आठ नंबर राशि का एक हमारा जबरदस्त संयोग आता है कि आठ नंबर राशि भी मंगल की है मंगल की ही है शेयर्ड बाय इंद्र
says: A strong point: sign 8 is also Mars's own sign, shared with Indra, so Scorpio has two lords in his scheme.
cells_derived_method: For any house with Scorpio, Mars and Uranus share it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra lagna has Scorpio as the 2nd, so speech and family wealth get both Mars and Uranus.
Derived: Taurus lagna has Scorpio as the 7th, which gives a sharp, sudden partner and marriage ups and downs.

classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Scorpio to Mars only.

hindi: 12 ग्रह 12 राशियां 12 पोर्टल्स
says: He lays out the frame of his system: 12 planets, 12 signs and 12 portals, one for each.
ambiguity: Portals are not defined here.
classical_check: Differs from classical 9 planets; the extra three are Uranus, Neptune and Pluto.

gist: Jokes that Indra, Varuna and Yama were never discussed before and that he took the material like stolen goods.
Says this number 8 comes up automatically on its own.
Says people ask who his guru is and he calls all this idle chatter.
Says God placed strong planets in his fifth house through his parents' effort, so he gets it free.
Jokes that he is eating on free grace and did not earn it.

hindi: पंचम भाव में यदि मंगल का योग किसी प्रकार का बैठ जाए पंचम भाव में मंगल की कृपा बैठ जाए यहां इंटूटिव पावर्स दे देगा
says: If Mars connects with the 5th house in any way, the native gets intuitive powers.
cells_derived_method: Mars's intuition result depends on the sign in the 5th and what Mars rules from there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 5th (Sagittarius lagna), own sign, strong gut feeling.
Derived: Mars in Capricorn in the 5th (Virgo lagna) is exalted, trained and disciplined intuition.
Derived: Mars in Cancer in the 5th (Pisces lagna) is debilitated, so the intuition is emotional and may mislead.

ambiguity: 'Yoga of any kind' covers conjunction, aspect or placement.
classical_check: Classical Mars in the 5th is usually weak for children and mind; intuition is his own claim.

hindi: बहुत मजे की बात बिना गुरु ही ज्ञान की प्राप्ति होगी आपने गुरु बनाया तो आप नहीं कर पाओगे
says: With Mars acting on the 5th, knowledge comes without a guru, and taking a guru would actually stop you from achieving it.
cells_derived_method: Same house for all signs; the mechanism is self-learning from past-life merit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Scorpio in the 5th (Cancer lagna), Mars in its own sign, a self-taught researcher type.
Derived: Libra lagna has Aquarius as the 5th; Mars here is an outsider in Saturn's sign, learning alone but doubting.

classical_check: Silent; classical texts give no such guru prohibition.

hindi: जिस बच्चे का पंचम भाव से मंगल यहां से दृष्टि हो गई आठ नंबर की बात करेंगे बीच में आ गया यहां से दृष्टि यहां आ गई
says: For a child whose Mars looks at the 5th house by aspect, the same intuitive result applies; he mentions that the sign-8 aspect point comes in between.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects the 4th, 7th and 8th from itself, so it can hit the 5th from the 2nd (4th sight), the 11th (7th sight) or the 10th (8th sight).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 11th (Gemini lagna) aspects the 5th by its 7th sight.
Derived: Mars in Leo in the 2nd (Cancer lagna) aspects the 5th by its 4th sight, also affecting speech and family.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 10th (Aries lagna) aspects the 5th by its 8th sight, giving a forceful intuitive push.

ambiguity: Gesture-based; exact houses in the diagram are not clear from the caption.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars has 4th, 7th and 8th aspects.

hindi: या यहां बैठा हुआ है या चलित भाव और निर्ण भाव केपी कुंडली चलित कुंडली
says: The Mars link to the 5th counts whether Mars sits there, or reaches it in the bhava chalit, nirayana bhava or KP chart, so shifting house placement in those charts is included.
cells_derived_method: A planet near a house boundary can fall in the neighbouring house in chalit or KP, so check all of them.
ambiguity: Unclear whether he means Sripati or nirayana house for 'nirn bhava'.
classical_check: Agrees that bhava chalit and KP can move a planet to another house.

hindi: अपनी कुंडली में मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली में मंगल यूं यू यूं खिसक रहा है और यहां काम कर रहा है
says: In the Munna Bhai (example) chart, Mars shifts step by step in the chalit and ends up working in the 5th house.
ambiguity: The chart's real data is not given in the caption.
classical_check: Agrees in principle that chalit can move a planet to the next house.

hindi: आप हर हालत में आंख बंद के कह दो भाई तो अल्ट साइंस की पढ़ाई करेगा क्योंकि मंगल की यहां से यहां भी एस्पेक्ट आ जाता है
says: With Mars acting on the 5th in D1 or chalit, you can say without checking that the child will study alternative or occult science, because Mars's aspect reaches the 5th from more than one position.
cells_derived_method: The occult study tendency is the same for all signs, but the field varies with the sign in the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 5th (Cancer lagna) gives a self-taught researcher who studies the occult.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 5th (Virgo lagna) gives a disciplined, technical occult learner.

ambiguity: 'Alt science' may mean astrology, tarot or similar.
classical_check: Silent; classical rules link 5th house and Jupiter to learning, not Mars to occult study.

hindi: ये एक नंबर है ये आठ नंबर है काल पुरुष की पक्के भाव की कुंडली बात करें जो लाल किताब फॉलो करती है एक और आठ ये मंगल है
says: In the Kalapurusha natural chart, the fixed (pakka) houses of Lal Kitab, he gives Mars to houses 1 and 8, matching Aries and Scorpio.
cells_derived_method: In the natural zodiac chart house 1 is Aries and house 8 is Scorpio, both Mars's.
ambiguity: Lal Kitab pakka ghar of Mars is 3 and 8, not 1 and 8; he mixes it with the Kalapurusha zodiac.
classical_check: Differs: Lal Kitab's pakka houses for Mars are 3 and 8; Kalapurusha gives 1 and 8.

hindi: यहां पर ल्ट है और ये तो पूर्व जन्म का भी हो गया पितरों का भी हो गया भाग्य भी हो गया संचित कर्मों का फल भी हो गया
says: With Mars here, occult talent is present, and it stands for past-life merit, ancestors, fortune and the fruit of stored karma all together.
cells_derived_method: The past-life and ancestor topics are those of the 5th, 9th and 8th houses combined.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 9th (Leo lagna) strengthens fortune through father and ancestors.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 8th (Gemini lagna) suggests hidden inherited gain.

ambiguity: 'Here' is a gesture, likely the 5th house with the sign 8 link.
classical_check: Agrees that the 5th is purva punya; adding Mars is his own.

hindi: तो रेडीमेड है ना यानी इस जन्म में क्या टका किया है इस जन्म में करना ही नहीं है पिछले जन्म की खानी है बैठ के रोटी
says: So the result is readymade: nothing needs to be earned this life because the native can sit and eat the bread earned in the previous birth.
ambiguity: Said partly in humour; it is not a literal instruction to avoid work.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with purva punya of the 5th; the phrase is his own.

hindi: कैसे खानी है मंगल ऑन रखो मेहनत मत करो
says: His advice for such a person: keep Mars switched on and do not push by hard effort, since results come through the Mars link and not through labour.
ambiguity: 'Keep Mars on' is not defined, no remedy named.
classical_check: Silent; karma texts instead say effort is needed.

gist: Garbled line about doing well in study and someone with a different kind of planet.

hindi: क्योंकि यहां पर यदि शनि का लिंक आ जाए तो पढ़ाई का विद्या का लाभ नहीं देता
says: If Saturn links to this place (the 5th house with Mars), education does not give its benefit, so studies do not pay off.
cells_derived_method: Saturn's effect on the 5th depends on its sign and lordship.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries in the 5th (Sagittarius lagna) strongly blocks the benefit of studies.
Derived: Saturn exalted in Libra in the 5th (Gemini lagna) delays learning but gives disciplined, slow payoff.

ambiguity: 'Link' may be conjunction or aspect.
classical_check: Agrees in general that Saturn on the 5th delays or reduces learning.

gist: Says lakhs of people studied engineering, went into architecture, then a job and Canada PR.

hindi: अब मंगल क्या कराता है यह आपको टैरो में डालेगा टैरोट कार्ड रीडिंग कराएगा
says: This Mars influence pushes the person into tarot, making them learn card reading.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह ज्योतिष में डाल देगा ज्योतिष की तरफ भयंकर रुझान होगा
says: The same Mars influence also draws the person to astrology with a very strong pull.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link astrology skill to Mercury, Jupiter and the 5th.

gist: Sentence cut off about a fire inside the mind making you influenced automatically.

hindi: होंगे आपके अंदर ये भविष्य को जानने की शक्ति नाभी है सबके पास
says: Continuing the Mars-in-the-5th theme, he says such a person develops an inner ability to sense the future, and ties that sense to the navel centre.
cells_derived_method: The future-sensing result is the same for all signs; its style depends on the sign Mars is in. Fire signs give sudden hunches, water signs give feeling-based knowing.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 5th (Sagittarius lagna) gives sharp, immediate hunches.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 5th (Pisces lagna) gives feeling-based premonitions that can be unreliable.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 5th (Virgo lagna) gives practical foresight about plans and outcomes.

ambiguity: 'Here' in the earlier lines is assumed to be the 5th house.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts give prediction skill to Mercury, Jupiter and the 5th and 9th, not Mars.

hindi: नाभी सबके पास है किसी का हाथ कटा है किसी का पैर कटा है किसी की आंख फूट गई नाभी सबके पास है
says: Everyone has a navel even if an arm, leg or eye is lost, so the navel centre is the one body part that is universal, and that is why Mars's reach is universal.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own reasoning for Mars as a universal planet.

hindi: तो मंगल इन्फ्लुएंस करता है सबको
says: Because the navel is in everybody, Mars influences every person, whatever their chart.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts treat Mars's effect as chart-dependent, not universal.

hindi: ग्रेट ऑरेटर्स होते हैं ग्रेट सेनापति होते हैं ग्रेट फाइटर्स होते हैं ये सब मंगल है
says: Great orators, great army commanders and great fighters all come from Mars's influence.
classical_check: Agrees on commanders and fighters; orators are usually Mercury or Jupiter, so partly differs.

hindi: तो आपके लिंगक पार्टी मित्रता कैसे है सोशल सर्कल बन गया मंगल राहु बनाता है
says: Your links, parties and friendships, that is your social circle, are formed by Mars working with Rahu. The caption is rough, so this is a best reading.
ambiguity: Word 'lingak' is probably 'link'; the exact mechanism is unclear.
classical_check: Classical friends are the 11th house; Mars and Rahu as the social circle is his own idea.

hindi: राहु भी हाथ जोड़ता है मंगल को राहु जैसे प्लेनेट को सिर्फ मंगल ही पकड़ सकता है
says: Rahu bows to Mars, and only Mars is strong enough to catch a planet like Rahu.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts say Rahu acts like Saturn and gives no such rank to Mars.

hindi: नहीं तो राहु किसको खा जाता है राहु सूर्य को भी खा जाता है और राहु बृहस्पति को भी ऐसी तैसी फेर देता है
says: Rahu swallows the Sun and also wrecks Jupiter, so with those two it dominates unless something stronger holds it.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu with the Sun makes a grahan yoga and with Jupiter a guru-chandal yoga, both afflictions.

hindi: और बृहस्पति ही राहु को थोड़ा सेट कर सकता है अगर ठीक हो और मंगल ही कर सकता है हनुमान के बस का ही है
says: Only a healthy Jupiter can partly settle Rahu, and Mars can also do it, because it is within Hanuman's power.
classical_check: Silent on Mars controlling Rahu; Jupiter's aspect on Rahu as a cure is a common idea.

hindi: आपका मंगल यहां पर लिंक रख गया किसी भी तरह से आप ओ कल्ट में इंटरेस्टेड हो जाओगे
says: If your Mars has any link to this place (the 5th house), you will become interested in the occult.
cells_derived_method: Interest in the occult shows in different ways by sign; water signs lean to psychic feeling, fire signs to rituals and energy work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Scorpio in the 5th (Cancer lagna), deep interest in hidden and mystical subjects.
Derived: Mars in Leo in the 5th (Aries lagna), a showman interest in occult performance and leadership.
Derived: Mars in Pisces in the 5th (Scorpio lagna), a devotional and intuitive pull to the occult.

ambiguity: 'Here' is assumed to be the 5th house from the earlier lines.
classical_check: Silent; classics link occult to the 8th and 12th houses, Rahu and Ketu.

hindi: आप टैरो करोगे आप किसी किस्म का वास्तु करोगे आप ज्योतिष में पड़ जाओगे
says: The forms this interest takes are tarot, some kind of vastu practice, and astrology itself.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जब पढ़ोगे पेपरों के दिनों में पढ़ाई के टाइम में दसवीं 12वीं क्लास जब हो आप जितना कम पढ़ोगे उतने ज्यादा मार्क्स आएंगे
says: In 10th and 12th board exam time, a person with this Mars link will score better the less he studies.
cells_derived_method: Result is claimed for any sign; the claim is a direct effect of the Mars link in the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Taurus in the 5th (Capricorn lagna), steady exam luck but slower intuition than fire signs.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 5th (Sagittarius lagna), quick last-minute grasp before exams.

ambiguity: This is a strong claim and clearly only a tendency, not a study instruction.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Voices an objection in the listener's voice: how can that be when the book has 200 pages.

hindi: मंगल क्या करेगा आपको फुरलू फुरलू कराएगा यह वाला पढ़ लू यह वाला पढ़ लू
says: Mars makes you flit and pick certain chapters to read, as a sudden urge to read this part and that part.
ambiguity: Colloquial 'furlu furlu' means quick, light, impulsive.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पता नहीं कैसे आपको ज्ञान होगा कि यह वाले चैप्टर पढ़ लो उसी में से क्वेश्चन आएंगे पास
says: Without knowing why, you get the inner knowledge of which chapters to read, and the exam questions come from exactly those, so you pass.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह चमत्कार करेगा आपका मंगल यहां बैठा है लॉटरी लग कराएगा
says: Your Mars sitting here can work a miracle and make a lottery win happen. This is only his claim about lottery luck, not advice to gamble.
cells_derived_method: Lottery or speculative luck is a 5th-house topic; sign changes how steady it is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 5th (Cancer lagna) gives sudden windfall tendency.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 5th (Pisces lagna), a windfall tendency that is unstable.

ambiguity: Caption word 'lottery g' is read as lottery lagna (hit).
classical_check: Classical 5th house does link to speculation; the Mars link is his own.

hindi: लॉटरी के टिकट जिन लोगों के लगते हैं मंगल का यह लिंक होना जरूरी है तभी आपकी लॉटरी लगेगी
says: People whose lottery tickets win must have this Mars link; without it the lottery will not hit. This is not betting advice.
ambiguity: The claim is stated as a necessary condition, which is unproven.
classical_check: Silent; classics list Jupiter and the 5th, 8th and 11th for sudden gain.

hindi: मकान आ गया लॉटरी कैसे पैसे आ गए भाई मजा आ गया यार झटके से प्राप्ति क्योंकि फ्री फंड में देता है
says: A house or money arrives suddenly, as if from nowhere, because Mars gives free of effort, without the person working for it.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: खाया पिया और भूल गए भूलने की शक्ति हनुमान ने कभी क्रेडिट नहीं लिया मैं मैं करके लाया हूं कुछ नहीं
says: This Mars type eats, drinks and forgets, with a power of forgetting; like Hanuman he never takes credit or says 'I did it'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए इसको हम भाड़ में जाय का चक्र कहते हैं
says: For this reason he names this principle the 'let it go to the oven' wheel, a let-go-of-it rule of Mars.
ambiguity: Caption writes 'gay' for 'jaye'; meaning is 'let it burn' i.e. let it go.
classical_check: His own coined term; not in classical texts.

hindi: आपका मंगल जहां भी पंगा डाल के कुंडली में बैठ गया है उस स्थान के बारे में भाड़ में भेज दो आपको वो गोद में आके गिरेगी
says: Wherever Mars sits in your chart and makes trouble, stop worrying about that house's matters and let them go, and the result will drop into your lap.
cells_derived_method: The remedy applies to whichever house holds Mars, so the topic to let go changes by house. Mars in the 7th means marriage, the 2nd money and family, the 10th career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 7th (Cancer lagna), let go of anxiety about the partner and the partner comes easily.
Derived: Mars in Gemini in the 2nd (Taurus lagna), stop obsessing about savings and speech and money flows.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 10th (Libra lagna), stop forcing career and it is said to come by itself.

ambiguity: Whether this is a literal mental stance or a ritual is not said.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own mental remedy.

hindi: आपने जितना क्लेश दिमाग में मचाया उतना ही सत्यानाश
says: The more mental agitation you create about that area, the more it is ruined, so worry makes the Mars matter worse.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: और 100% शोर शॉट आप नाम अकेला रखते हो या अकेले रहना पसंद करते हो
says: A sure-shot sign of troubled Mars is that a person keeps to himself or likes staying alone. The caption part about the name is garbled.
ambiguity: 'naam akela rakhte ho' is unclear and may be a caption error.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: या आपके घर घर ग्रहस्ती के अंदर पति-पत्नी में कलेश है मंगल डिस्टर्ब है ही
says: If there is quarrelling between husband and wife at home, Mars is surely disturbed.
ambiguity: He states it as certain, a strong claim.
classical_check: Agrees in general that Mars afflicts marriage through the 7th house connection.

hindi: मंगलिक दोष का लफड़ा यही है
says: This domestic quarrel and loneliness is what the manglik dosha problem is about.
classical_check: Agrees that manglik dosha is about marital friction; classical definition is by house.

hindi: आपका मंगल एक च सा 8 12
says: Mars in the houses 1, 4, 7, 8 or 12 is the manglik placement; the caption writes the numbers roughly.
cells_derived_method: The strength of manglik effect depends on the sign. Own or exalted Mars in a kendra gives a mahapurusha-like cancellation; debilitated Mars in the 8th is the hardest.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 7th (Cancer lagna), strong and forceful partner life, dosha softened by Ruchaka yoga.
Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 4th (Capricorn lagna), Ruchaka yoga that cancels the dosha but gives a hot home.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 8th (Sagittarius lagna), the severest case.
Derived: Mars in Taurus in the 12th (Gemini lagna), bedroom friction and expense, in Venus's sign.

ambiguity: The caption numbers are garbled; reading 1, 4, 7, 8, 12 matches the classical list. The 2nd house is not mentioned.
classical_check: Agrees: the classical manglik houses are 1, 4, 7, 8 and 12, with some adding the 2nd.

gist: An imagined listener objects that a person may simply not want to engage with worldly things.
Garbled lines about one direction, 10 out of 100 or 1000, not necessarily Mars.

hindi: जिन्होंने बताया कि छोड़ो क्या रखा है दुनियादारी के अंदर दुनिया में ऐसे भी लोग होते हैं छोड़ो परे इनका केतु सेट कर गया मंगल को
says: People who say worldly life is worthless and renounce it have a Ketu that has acted on their Mars.
ambiguity: 'Set' is read as 'worked on' or 'overpowered'.
classical_check: Agrees roughly that Ketu with Mars gives detachment; Ketu is the moksha karaka.

hindi: कैसी अजीब बात है मजेदार ये केतु है केतु कह रहा है साधु बन जाओ छोड़ो यार क्या रखा
says: Ketu itself is the voice telling you to become an ascetic and drop everything because nothing is worth it.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the planet of renunciation.

hindi: राहु क्या है नेत्र देखता है चेहरा है राहु केतु क्या है धड़ सुनता ही नहीं का फर्क नहीं पड़ता यार
says: Rahu is the head with eyes, so it sees, while Ketu is the headless torso that cannot hear, so no one's call affects it.
classical_check: Agrees with the myth: Rahu is the head and Ketu the body.

hindi: अब साधु बन गए फकीर बन गए यार आप में फकीरी आ गई
says: The result is that the person turns ascetic and fakir-like, a wanderer's indifference arriving in his nature.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: Ketu influence gives renunciation.

hindi: केतु बादल है धुए का बादल मंगल के पीछे पीछे चलता है धूम केतु
says: Ketu is a cloud of smoke that follows behind Mars, the dhoom-ketu of the old texts.
classical_check: Dhumketu is a classical name for comets and Ketu; linking it as Mars's follower is his own.

hindi: जहां आग होती है वहां धुआ होता ही है जहां धुआ होता है वहां आग हो जरूरी नहीं है लेकिन जहां आग होती है वहां धुआ जरूर होता है
says: Where there is fire there is always smoke, but smoke does not need fire, so Mars (fire) always carries Ketu (smoke) along, while Ketu can exist without Mars.
ambiguity: The logic as spoken is loose, since smoke without fire is not what he says in the middle.
classical_check: Silent; poetic reasoning, not a classical rule.

hindi: केतु जब न होता है तो बादल की तरह बन जाता है तो सूर्य के आगे आ गया तो पता नहीं चलता रात को चंदा मामा के सामने दिखता नहीं
says: Ketu acts like a cloud: when it comes in front of the Sun you cannot tell the Sun is there, and at night it hides the Moon, so Ketu masks the planet it falls on.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu with the Sun or Moon obscures their results (eclipse-like).

hindi: ऐसे ही मंगल के आगे आ गया बादल तो पता नहीं फिर मन में फकीरी आ जाती है
says: In the same way, when the Ketu cloud covers Mars, Mars's drive is hidden and the mind turns ascetic.
ambiguity: Whether 'in front of' means conjunction or aspect is not said.
classical_check: Agrees in general that Ketu with Mars gives detachment and low ambition.

hindi: ये काफी इल्यूजन के बाद केतु भी यही है राहु भी इल्यूजन है अधूरे हैं ना
says: Rahu and Ketu are both illusions and are incomplete, a head only and a body only, so what they show is not the full truth.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu and Ketu are shadow planets associated with maya.

hindi: ये क्लेरिटी इज मंगल गोला क्लियर अच्छी बात मंगल अच्छा होता है
says: Clarity is Mars's gift, and a clear Mars is a good thing, the opposite of the foggy Rahu and Ketu.
ambiguity: 'Gola clear' is a garbled phrase.
classical_check: Silent on clarity as a Mars quality.

gist: Says he is not against people who do not go into hypnosis and that everyone follows their own way.
Says he avoids remarks about religion because there is pointless controversy these days.

hindi: अगर आप राम राम नाम में लगे तो भी हिप्नोसिस में है आपको राम मिलेगा कृष्ण कृष्ण कर रहे हैं कृष्ण को आप मिल गए आपको कृष्ण मिलेगा
says: Chanting Ram or Krishna is also a form of self-hypnosis: you get the deity you chant and the deity gets you.
classical_check: Silent; this is a devotional-psychological claim.

hindi: सवाल यह उठता है वह देवता हमारे लिए आ रहा है कि नहीं आ रहा है
says: The real question is whether the deity is actually coming for us or not, that is, whether the connection is returned.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Tells of a follower who keeps saying Guruji and wants darshan.
The follower wants to sit at his feet and press them, and Gautam answers that his feet do not hurt.
Gautam says he has only five or seven minutes because of the crowd; the visitor insists on two hours and he replies supply and demand are both with the visitor.
Gautam says he would be the visitor's servant if tied on a leash and made to sit for two hours.
The visitor says we have accepted you and you found me.

hindi: ऐसे ही राम कृष्ण तुम्हें कृष्ण मिला कृष्ण ने तुम्हें स्वीकारा राम ने तुम्हें स्वीकारा
says: Finding Krishna or Ram is not enough; the point is whether Krishna or Ram accepted you in return.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हम दीवाने हो चुके हैं इस जॉब के प्रति जॉब ने तुम्हें स्वीकारा तब तो जॉब तुम्हें प्रमोशन देगा जॉब तुम्हें प्रमोशन नहीं दे रहा जॉब ने तुम्हें नहीं स्वीकारा
says: Being crazy about your job does not matter unless the job accepts you; if it accepts you it gives promotion, and if no promotion comes the job has not accepted you.
cells_derived_method: Career is a 10th-house topic, so acceptance by the work depends on the 10th house, its lord and Mars's link.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Aries in the 10th (Cancer lagna), the job rewards bold effort, promotion follows if accepted.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 10th (Libra lagna), the job tends not to accept a forceful style.

ambiguity: Not tied to a specific planet by him.
classical_check: Silent; classical rules for promotion use the 10th and 11th lords and dasha.

hindi: मैं अपने पति की सेवा कर रही हूं दिन रात लगी रहती हूं सास के पांव दबाती हूं क्या उन्होंने तुम्हें स्वीकारा नहीं
says: Serving the husband day and night and pressing the mother-in-law's feet means nothing unless they accept you; if the family has not accepted you, the service is not working.
cells_derived_method: Acceptance in marriage maps to the 7th house, the partner, and the 4th and 2nd for the in-laws' household.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 7th (Cancer lagna), the husband is dominant and acceptance depends on matching his strength.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 4th (Capricorn lagna), a hot household where service alone may not earn acceptance.

ambiguity: The house link is derived, not stated by him.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मैं बहुत निष्ठावान कार्य करता हूं उस कार्य ने आपको स्वीकारा
says: Being very sincere in your work is not the test; the test is whether the work has accepted you.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut short; the negative part is implied from the next lines.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मैंने बहुत धन कमाया धन ने आपको स्वीकारा नहीं धन चला जाएगा
says: If you earned a lot of money but the money has not accepted you, it will leave. This is his claim about wealth, not investment advice.
cells_derived_method: Wealth is the 2nd and 11th house topic; acceptance by money varies with the sign and lord there.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in Gemini in the 2nd (Taurus lagna), earned money tends to flow out through talk and restlessness.
Derived: Mars in Aries in the 11th (Gemini lagna), gains come in bursts but can be lost fast.

ambiguity: Houses 2 and 11 are inferred, not named by him.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मंगल की स्ट्रेंथ चाहिए नाभी पर ही विल पावर होती है नाभी पर ही भाड़ में जाय होता है
says: You need Mars's strength; willpower sits at the navel, and the let-it-go attitude also works from the navel.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars is the karaka of willpower and courage; the navel link is his own.

hindi: आप इसलिए कर रहे हो कि दूसरे को खरीद लो आपने कर दिया हनुमान है भूल गए दफा कर क्या रखा है
says: If you serve only to buy the other person's favour, it is a transaction; Hanuman serves and forgets, so true Mars service expects nothing back.
ambiguity: Partly garbled caption.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: राम ने अपने आप हनुमान उठा दिया तुम मेरे सखा हो तुम मेरे भाई हो मित्र हो राम ने शब्द कहे यह शास्त्रों में आते हैं हनुमान कहता मैं आपका सेवक
says: Ram himself lifted Hanuman and called him friend and brother, while Hanuman kept saying he is only the servant, and he notes these words are found in the scriptures, showing that acceptance comes to the one who asks nothing.

classical_check: Agrees with the Ramayana story; the astrological use for Mars is his own.

gist: Krishna calls Arjuna his brother and Arjuna bows at Krishna's feet, an illustration of mutual acceptance.

hindi: आप सोच के चले कैसा गुथा हुआ रिश्ता ऐसा पति पत्नी का होता है तो लड़ाई झगड़े टेंशन नहीं होती
says: If husband and wife have a tightly woven bond of mutual acceptance like this, there is no fighting or tension in the marriage.
cells_derived_method: Marriage is the 7th house; a Mars affliction there breaks this bond, a calm 7th keeps it. The sign in the 7th sets the style of bond.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 7th (Cancer lagna), a strong bond is possible but the partner is forceful.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 7th (Capricorn lagna), a bond that cracks under emotional heat.

ambiguity: He does not link this to a house; the 7th is inferred.
classical_check: Silent; marriage harmony is read from the 7th house, its lord and Venus.

hindi: ऐसा आपका दूसरी चीज से रिश्ता होना चाहिए आपकी जॉब से मित्रता आपके कार्य से मित्रता
says: The same close friendship should exist between you and your job and your work, not only between you and your spouse.
cells_derived_method: Work is the 10th house; the sign and any Mars link there show whether the friendship with work forms easily.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign Aries in the 10th (Cancer lagna), a natural friendship with a hard-driving career.
Derived: Mars in Libra in the 10th (Capricorn lagna), friendship with work comes through partnership and negotiation.

ambiguity: No house named by him.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मंगलिक कर देता है एक चार सात आ 12 इसका मतलब क्या है कि मंगल की अगर यहां बैठा है कुंडली में
says: Mars makes a person manglik when it sits in house 1, 4, 7, 8 or 12 of the chart; he then begins to explain what that means.
cells_derived_method: The manglik dosha is read from the house and sign. Own or exalted Mars in a kendra is milder; debilitated Mars or Mars in the 8th and 12th is stronger.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn in the 7th (Cancer lagna), manglik but a Ruchaka yoga softens it.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 8th (Sagittarius lagna), a heavy manglik case.
Derived: Mars in own sign Scorpio in the 12th (Sagittarius lagna), manglik with loss and bed-pleasure friction.
Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer in the 4th (Aries lagna), manglik with domestic unrest.

ambiguity: Caption reads 'ek char saat aa 12' and the 8 is dropped by the caption.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical list of 1, 4, 7, 8, 12.

hindi: तो आपकी शादी का तो यह लफड़ा डाल देगा क्योंकि ब्रह्मचारी है

hindi: आपके जीवन में घर ग्रहस्ती के लिए दोनों तत्वों की बैलेंसिंग जरूरी है

hindi: ऐसे भी घर हैं जहां स्त्री ने ही घर की बैलेंसिंग कर रखी है और पुरुष उसका सपोर्ट कर रहा है इसका यह मतलब नहीं वो स्त्री बन गया है

hindi: स्त्री पैसे को कमा के दे रही है लेकिन उसने स्त्री तत्व नहीं छोड़ा है पुरुष घर के काम संभालता है लेकिन उसने पुरुष तत्त्व नहीं छोड़ा है

hindi: जो गैंबलिंग करते हैं जुआ खेलते हैं उनका क्या शनि वो तो शनि सही होना चाहिए

hindi: जो गैंबलिंग का जुआ है उसके लिए शनि राहु ये सब काम पावरफुल होने चाहिए

hindi: अगर मंगल सेट नहीं करोगे तो अग्नि के फेरे कभी मत करो अन्यथा कुंभ विवाह कराना पड़ेगा

hindi: लड़की मंगली के तो उसका कुंभ विवाह होता है तभी करो शादी नहीं तो शादी मत करो

hindi: लेकिन मल्टीपल ग्रह चलते हैं एक ग्रह कभी नहीं चलता इसलिए समस्या हो जाती है
