hindi: जितने लोग ये रम्मी सर्कल खेल रहे हैं ना कर्जा ले लेके किडनी बेच के और अपने घर के कागजात रख के सब लुट जाते क्योंकि वो कैसे खेल रहे हैं नाभी तो स्ट्रंग है ही नहीं डरी हुई नाभी काम कर रही है
says: All who play rummy online on borrowed money, selling kidneys or mortgaging house papers, lose because their navel is not strong and a fearful navel is doing the playing. This is a warning, not gambling advice.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Imagines a gambler who thinks one win will clear the debt, goes from a 10 to 15 lakh debt and finally has to sell a kidney.
Jokes that people should not sell a kidney except maybe for an iPhone, which he says is happening.
Joke about someone who sold an eye while we do not sell a kidney; lead-in to the Mars remedy talk.

hindi: मंगल के लिए आपको किसी हालत के अंदर भी अपने अंदर का चारित्रिक गुण खराब नहीं होने देना
says: For a Mars remedy the person must not let his own character and conduct slip under any circumstance; Mars is kept healthy by discipline of character, not only by objects.
classical_check: Classical texts link Mars to courage and conduct only loosely; this behavioural condition is his own emphasis.

hindi: मूंगा पहनने से मत कतरा
says: Do not shy away from wearing red coral for Mars; he recommends the gem directly instead of avoiding it.
ambiguity: Short imperative; the conditions come in the next sentences.
classical_check: Classical texts allow coral only for a well-placed Mars or its lord-ship benefic for the lagna; he is more liberal.

hindi: एक बड़ा भारी भ्रांति है क्लेश दिमाग में फसा हुआ है और वो यही कहते हैं स्टोन नहीं ... कोई भी जोशी स्टोन क्यों नहीं पहना आता सस्ते सस्ते उपाय क्यों कराता है
says: He says people carry a big misconception that gemstones should not be worn, and he complains that astrologers avoid prescribing stones and push cheap rituals instead.
ambiguity: Caption is run-on; the target of the complaint is astrologers in general.
classical_check: Classical texts do prescribe ratna and mantra both; this is a criticism of practice, not a rule.

gist: Mocks cheap rituals: a 500 rupee rooster, a few thousand for a ritual, then whether it worked or not nobody checks.

hindi: उपाय से भी काम होता है ऐसी बात नहीं है पर हैवी चीज है
says: Cheap ritual remedies can also work, he concedes, but a heavy problem is a heavy thing and needs a heavier remedy than a small ritual.
ambiguity: A word before the remedy is garbled in the caption.
classical_check: Silent; graded remedy strength is a general tradition idea.

hindi: आपको खांसी हो रही है दो चार दिन से तो पाचर की गोली काम करती है ... लेकिन अगर 6 साल से चल रही है खांसी तो कोई सर्जरी या एमआरआई का काम होगा अब अगर प्रॉब्लम बहुत लंबी है तो बड़ा उपाय कराना है
says: Analogy: a cough of a few days is cured by a simple pill but a six year cough needs scans or surgery; likewise a long-standing planetary problem needs a big remedy. The medical part is only an analogy, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Humility remark: critics are not at fault, it is the Supreme who gives, we are only instruments; he bows to anyone who truly knows.
We should always keep increasing our knowledge, even if we already know a lot, and keep learning from others.
Personal habit: he grabs anyone who knows something, asks to be taught, and offers to teach in exchange.

hindi: पंडित लोग क्या करते डरते हैं कि इसको मूंगा पहना देंगे नुकसान ना हो जाए
says: Many pandits are afraid to give coral because they fear it may harm the native; he states this as the common reason astrologers refuse Mars gem.
classical_check: Agrees that tradition warns about coral for a malefic-lord lagna; he argues against that fear.

hindi: भैया तेरा ना यहां पर यहां का मालिक है मंगल यहां का मालिक है यहां का मालिक है इसको नहीं पहनाए पहना सकते हैं
says: If Mars is the owner (lord) of the place being discussed on the chart, coral can be worn; the objection of the pandit does not stand because the lord is Mars.
cells_derived_method: Which houses Mars lords depends on lagna: Aries lagna 1 and 8, Taurus 7 and 12, Gemini 6 and 11, Cancer 5 and 10, Leo 4 and 9, Virgo 3 and 8, Libra 2 and 7, Scorpio 1 and 6, Sagittarius 5 and 12, Capricorn 4 and 11, Aquarius 3 and 10, Pisces 2 and 9. The coral case is stronger when the owned house is a trikona or kendra.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer lagna has Mars as lord of 5 and 10 (yogakaraka) so coral is easy to justify even if Mars is in a weak sign.
Derived: Virgo lagna with Mars in Aries in the 8th; Mars lords 3 and 8, so coral is the debatable case he wants to allow.
Derived: Scorpio lagna, Mars is lagna lord in own sign, coral most supported.

ambiguity: He points at the chart with here/here; which house or sign is meant cannot be heard from the caption.
classical_check: Partly agrees: lord of a trikona or lagna is the classical basis for a gem; he extends it to any ownership.

hindi: इसका तरीका पहनने का उंगली फर्क होगी लॉकेट में होगा गले में होगा
says: The way of wearing the coral can differ by case: as a finger ring or as a locket on the neck instead of a ring.
ambiguity: The caption does not say which case needs the locket; it may be the cases where a finger ring is considered risky.
classical_check: Classical texts prescribe a finger ring (ring finger or index finger for Mars); a neck locket is a modern variant.

hindi: दूसरी उनकी समस्या क्या होती है मंगल यहां बैठा है ... खराब घर माने जाते हैं कहीं कहीं जाकर के स्पेसिफिक इसको भी पकड़ा जाता है कि मंगल यहां बैठा है य चार घरों में बैठा है नुकसानदायक
says: The second objection of astrologers: Mars sits in houses counted as bad, and in some schools specifically four houses are held harmful for Mars, so they refuse the gem.
cells_derived_method: Mars in houses held harmful (classical manglik set is 1, 4, 7, 8, 12, and 2 in some schools). Effect changes by house topic: 1 self, 4 home and mother, 7 spouse, 8 longevity and sudden events, 12 loss.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 7th in Libra, lagna Aries; the spouse-house objection a pandit would raise.
Derived: Mars in the 4th in Cancer (debilitated), lagna Aries, objection about home and mother.
Derived: Mars in the 12th in Gemini, lagna Cancer, objection about losses and bed pleasures.

ambiguity: Which four houses is not audible; the number four may be the caption's error for five (1, 4, 7, 8, 12).
classical_check: Agrees that Mars in 1, 4, 7, 8, 12 is the classical dosha set; he is reporting the objection, not endorsing it.

hindi: यह मान के चलो कि एक नंबर राशि का मालिक है एक नंबर का राशि का मालिक शराब पी के यहां पड़ा है ... इसके घर में कौन घुसा हुआ है जो भी दृष्टि दे रहा है वही चौड़ में चल रहा है तो इसके मालिक को जगाओ
says: Analogy: treat Mars as the owner of sign number 1 (Aries) lying drunk somewhere bad; whoever sits in or aspects its house is strutting around, so the way to fix the house is to wake the owner, which means strengthening Mars with coral.
cells_derived_method: The owner of any house or sign is strengthened to protect that house. Mars owns Aries and Scorpio (and Uranus for Scorpio in his scheme), so the houses ruled by those signs for each lagna are the ones protected.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna with Mars in Scorpio in the 8th; Mars owns the 1st and 8th and sits in own sign in a dusthana, waking it would protect self and longevity.
Derived: Aries lagna with Mars in Pisces in the 12th; the lagna lord is in loss house and others influence the lagna.
Derived: Aries lagna with Mars in Libra in the 7th; lagna lord pulled to the partner house.

ambiguity: Number 1 sign could mean Aries or the first house or the lagna lord; he uses sign numbering in this series.
classical_check: Classical texts agree the lord of a house decides the house results; the gem to wake a weak lord is a modern practice.

hindi: लोग कहेंगे अरे मृत्यु स्थान में बैठा है ऐसे नहीं पहनाते आंख मूंद के पहनाओ
says: If Mars is in the 8th (place of death), people will say do not give coral; he says give it with eyes shut, meaning wear it regardless of the 8th house placement.
cells_derived_method: For Mars in the 8th the lagna depends on the sign: sign number minus 8 plus 1. The strength of Mars changes by sign, own or exalted signs give more for the gem, a debilitated sign gives more need.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Aries, Mars in own sign in the 8th; coral supports stamina and longevity.
Derived: lagna Gemini, Mars exalted in the 8th; strong energy but hidden and sudden events, coral boosts further.
Derived: lagna Sagittarius, Mars debilitated in the 8th; he would still give coral to correct a weak Mars.

classical_check: Differs: classical advice avoids strengthening a planet in a dusthana through a gem; he says go ahead.

gist: Claims whoever has the experience can say it boldly; those who have not done it keep objecting that Mars is in the 8th house.

hindi: मैंने कह दिया मेरे लिए पेन बहुत बुरा है अब यह पेन बुराई है जिसने कह दिया अरे यह पेन कमाल होता है उसके लिए पेन कमाल क्योंकि अभी अभी मैंने इसके अंदर एनर्जी डाली है
says: Pen analogy: if I declare this pen bad for me, it becomes bad; the one who declares it wonderful gets a wonderful pen, because the declaring person puts energy into it. So the belief and energy of the one prescribing shapes the result.
ambiguity: The mapping from pen to chart is only an analogy for why differing astrologer methods all seem to work.
classical_check: Silent; this is a belief-based claim and not testable.

hindi: एक ज्योतिषी यह कहता है यहां से पित्र देखते हैं उसके बताने वाले लोगों के लिए पितर यहीं से आएंगे क्योंकि उसकी अपनी रा इनवेस्ट हो गई है
says: Different astrologers read the ancestors (pitr) from different houses; for the clients of an astrologer who says the pitr are read from a certain house, they will show from that house because the astrologer's own conviction is invested in it.
ambiguity: The house is pointed at on the board; likely the 9th for the father line, some schools use the 5th or 12th. Not audible.
classical_check: Classical reading: 9th house and Sun for father and ancestors; Jyotish schools differ, so he is right that houses differ.

hindi: हम बक रहे हैं यहां से होगा हमारे बताने से यहीं से आएंगे क्योंकि वह हमारे वाया काम कर रहे हैं
says: When I say it will come from here, it does come from here, because the ancestors are working through me as the channel; the assignment of a house becomes true through the speaker.
ambiguity: Caption is loose; the exact claim about who works through whom is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Repeats that one person says ancestors come from one house and for him they come from there.

hindi: टीले वाले बाबा जिन कॉन्शसनेस काम करती है नॉलेज गई भाड़ में उनके ऊपर कृपा का ग्रह स्ट्रांग है पांचवें नौवें घर में कृपा का ग्रह अगर स्ट्रंग है तो यह भूल जाओ वो क्या बता रहे हैं
says: Blessed baba types work through consciousness, not book knowledge; the planet of grace being strong in the 5th and 9th houses marks them, and then you can forget what technical thing they say, their word works.
cells_derived_method: Grace planet is read as Jupiter strong in the 5th or 9th (trikona). Strength depends on sign: own or exalted signs give the full effect. Lagna = sign number minus house plus 1.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: lagna Pisces, Jupiter exalted in the 5th; blessing through speech and mantra.
Derived: lagna Aries, Jupiter in own sign in the 9th; dharma and guru grace.
Derived: lagna Cancer, Jupiter in own sign in the 9th; spiritual protection, blessed speech.
Derived: lagna Leo, Jupiter in own sign in the 5th; mantra siddhi and wisdom.

ambiguity: Planet of grace is not named; read as Jupiter (also possibly Sun or Ketu).
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: 5th and 9th are trikonas and Jupiter is karaka of both; the claim that prediction accuracy no longer matters is his own.

hindi: गलत और सही को छोड़ दो उन्होंने जो बता दिया काम करेगा दैट इज फॉर श्योर क्योंकि वो ब्लेस्ड होते हैं
says: Ignore right and wrong technique: whatever a blessed person prescribes will work for sure because they are blessed.
classical_check: Silent; a belief claim.

Story of Ayurvedic doctors who check pulse and tongue and then say what is wrong in the body; a miracle analogy. Health claims not recorded.
They name the diseases only from the pulse, so there is real knowledge; so leave aside how they know it.

hindi: इसलिए बताने वाला कहता है यहां पहन के मूंगा सेट करेगा तो उसको करेगा फॉलो करो
says: Whatever the advising astrologer says, for instance wear the coral at this place and it will set the planet right, follow that instruction and do it.
ambiguity: The word here is a pointer to a finger or a part of the body, not audible.
classical_check: Classical: ring finger for Mars gem is common; silent on the specific finger he means.

hindi: कोई बोलता है तेरे को मीठा चॉकलेट यहां दान दे करेगा बोले ये उपाय का कोई सिर प्यार ही नहीं है
says: Someone prescribes donating sweets or chocolate at a certain place as a remedy, and others say that remedy has no logic at all; he mentions it as an example of odd remedies and does not endorse it.
ambiguity: The caption says sir pyar for sir pair (head and feet), meaning no logic; whether he endorses it is not clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लाल किताब के अनुसार तो यह खुला स्थान होता है यानी पानी का स्थान होता है यहां पर बादाम डालते हैं पानी
says: Per Lal Kitab this house or place is an open place meaning a water place, so the remedy is to put almonds into water there; an example of how one system gives a house a nature and a matching remedy.
ambiguity: Which house is not stated in the caption; he points at the chart.
classical_check: Lal Kitab is a separate system and not found in the Parashari classics; classical texts are silent on almond in water.

hindi: जिसने जिस तरह डेवलप कर लिया उसका वो बन जाएगा अगर उसको सिद्ध है
says: Whichever remedy method an astrologer has developed becomes effective for him if he has attained siddhi in it; the remedy works through the practitioner.
classical_check: Silent; belief claim.

gist: Without grace even good doctors have failed operations; grace matters.

hindi: आपकी ना भी डर के मारे रम्मी सर्कल खेल रही है ... रमी सर्कल मत खेलो जब तक आपको जुए के द्वारा लॉटरी गेंस नहीं हो तब तक बिल्कुल ना खेले
says: Advice against online rummy: do not play unless the chart shows gains from gambling or lottery. This is gambling advice from him; it is recorded only as his claim, not as advice to follow.
ambiguity: He does not say which chart factors show gambling gains; it is deferred to a later class.
classical_check: Classical texts link speculative gains to the 5th and 11th and 8th houses; he is silent on the specifics here.

gist: Says he charges 1100 to explain how it happens and will not tell it for free.

hindi: रम्मी सर्कल घर चल के आता है ऐसी स्थिति बन जाती है पैसा अंधा आता है लक्ष्मी चरणों में आती है वो आती है ब्र विष्णु के बृहस्पति की क्लास में बात करेंगे
says: When the chart supports it, gains from gambling come on their own, money comes blind and Lakshmi falls at the feet; the Jupiter link to Lakshmi and Vishnu will be explained in the Jupiter class. Recorded as his claim, not a recommendation.
ambiguity: The supporting chart condition is deferred.
classical_check: Silent in this sentence.

gist: Repeats that you should wear coral without worry; carries over to the next chunk.
Transition: besides the gem, he moves to a major point about Mars correction by sign, the sentence is trailing and partly garbled.

hindi: चार नंबर का मंगल है ये नीच का हो जाता है कहीं पर भी बैठा है
says: Mars in sign number 4 (Cancer) is debilitated, whichever house it sits in.
cells_derived_method: The debilitation fixed by sign, the effect varies by the house Cancer falls in for each lagna (lagna = 4 minus house plus 1) and by what Mars lords for that lagna.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer lagna, Mars is yogakaraka (5th and 10th lord) but debilitated in the lagna.
Derived: Aries lagna, lagna lord Mars debilitated in the 4th; home and mother matters.
Derived: Capricorn lagna, Mars as 4th and 11th lord debilitated in the 7th; partner friction.
Derived: Libra lagna, Mars as 2nd and 7th lord debilitated in the 10th; career and speech trouble.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars debilitates in Cancer.

gist: Digression: he says he is talking about good signs, then another thought crossed his mind in the middle.

hindi: नीच का है ये मारेगा ये कट लगाएगा ही लगाएगा
says: A debilitated Mars will hurt and will surely give cuts, meaning injuries and cuts in life, wherever it is.
cells_derived_method: Body area or life area hit follows the house Mars is in: 1 head, 2 face and throat, 3 arms, 6 enemies and accidents at work, 8 sudden injury, 12 feet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus lagna (4-3+1=2), Mars debilitated in the 3rd, cuts to arms and hands, courage drops.
Derived: Sagittarius lagna, Mars debilitated in the 8th, sudden injuries and hidden trouble.
Derived: Leo lagna, Mars debilitated in the 12th, injury or loss through feet and expenses.

ambiguity: No house stated; this is the general statement before he goes house by house.
classical_check: Agrees in general that a debilitated malefic gives hurt; the sureness is his emphasis.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया पैर में लगा देगा
says: Debilitated Mars sitting in a certain house will injure the leg or foot; the house is pointed on the board, probably the 12th (feet).
cells_derived_method: Foot and leg injury is the 12th house (feet) or lower body areas; other houses give other body parts.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo lagna, debilitated Mars in the 12th, the feet and legs injured.
Derived: Scorpio lagna, debilitated Mars in the 9th (thighs), thigh or hip injury is the alternative.

ambiguity: The house is not named; the 12th is inferred from the foot topic.
classical_check: Agrees that 12th is the feet in Kalapurusha; the exact claim is his.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया किडनी पकड़ लेगा एक साल का फेलियर दे देगा बच्चे को
says: Debilitated Mars here is said to grip the kidney and give the child a year of failure, probably a lost study year; the health word is his claim and not a diagnosis.
cells_derived_method: Child results are the 5th house; kidney is Libra and the 7th. So the house is probably the 5th or 7th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces lagna, debilitated Mars in the 5th, trouble in the child's studies.
Derived: Capricorn lagna, debilitated Mars in the 7th, kidney area (Libra) linked in his view.

ambiguity: House unnamed; the combined kidney and child result fits the 5th or 7th.
classical_check: Silent on kidney failure in this form.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया मम्मी के साथ रिलेशन खराब
says: Debilitated Mars placed here spoils the relationship with the mother; the topic points to the 4th house.
cells_derived_method: Mother is the 4th house; the same Mars in other houses affects other relations.

Derived: Libra lagna, Mars in the 10th aspects the 4th house by its 7th aspect, so the mother matters are touched from there.

classical_check: Agrees: Mars in the 4th harms domestic peace, and the 4th is the mother's house.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया तलाक करा देगा शराबी पति या पत्नी भी दिला सकता है कोई बड़ी बात नहीं चरित्र हीनता दे सकता है भटका सकता है

Derived: Aries lagna, Mars in the 4th looks at the 7th by its 4th aspect, so marriage is also affected.

classical_check: Agrees in general that malefic Mars in or aspecting the 7th harms marriage.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया काम का सत्यानाश भी कर सकता है लेकिन यह काम अंधा करा भी सकता है एस्पर और विचित्र चारित्रिक मूड साइ मूड मूड की मूवमेंट
says: Debilitated Mars here can ruin work, though it can also make a person work blindly and furiously, with odd mood swings and erratic character; reading the 10th house of work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra lagna, debilitated Mars in the 10th, career set back yet frantic work.
Derived: Aquarius lagna, debilitated Mars in the 6th, employment friction.

hindi: यहां बैठ गया गले की खराबी गला पकड़ेगा एक आंख के चोट दे सकता है करोड़पति भी बना सकता है

hindi: यहां बैठ गया भाइयों से सहोदर से झगड़ा
says: Debilitated Mars here brings quarrels with brothers and siblings; the 3rd house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus lagna, debilitated Mars in the 3rd; sibling quarrels and low courage.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini lagna (7-5+1=3), debilitated Sun in the 5th, father and ancestors line weak.
Derived: Cancer lagna (8-5+1=4), debilitated Moon in the 5th, mother line and mind.
Derived: Sagittarius lagna (1-5+1=-3, 9), debilitated Saturn in the 5th.
Derived: Virgo lagna (10-5+1=6), debilitated Jupiter in the 5th, blessing line weak.

ambiguity: It is not clear whether nice rashi means a debilitation sign or an inimical sign.
classical_check: Differs: classical pitru dosha is mainly Sun or Rahu or Saturn afflicting the 9th, or the 5th with malefics, not debilitation alone.

hindi: अगर पढ़ाई हमने दे दी बली पढ़ाई की तो फिर पितृ दोष सब अंग बचते जाएंगे जितनी बाहर की चोट एलाउ कर दोगे
says: If the sacrifice is given through education, then pitru dosha and the organs are saved; the more outer injuries one allows, the more the vital organs are saved.
ambiguity: Several words are garbled; the claim of organs being saved by outer injury is read from the closing words.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Anecdote about a policeman called Mangeram arriving at the house, after which a theft was found; used as a joke on small losses.

hindi: भाई साहब बाहर मिलो ना आप मिलो गेट पे मिल ली उसे घर मत दिखाओ
says: Analogy for the Mars sacrifice: treat the demanding Mars like a rough visitor, meet him outside at the gate and do not show him the house, meaning give the planet its toll in an outer matter and keep it away from the body and the core of life.
ambiguity: The opening words are cut from the previous chunk, so the exact opening of the analogy is missing.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own sacrifice principle (parivartan of harm to a lesser area).

hindi: उसे बोल भाई ले ले बली अभी तो हजार में मान जा मान जाएगा अगर नहीं तो अंदर घुसता चला जाएगा हजार रुप नहीं दोगे अगली बार अंदर आता जाएगा बॉडी के अंदर घुस जाएगा 10000 लेगा लाख लेगा
says: Tell Mars to take the sacrifice now, he agrees for a thousand; if you refuse the small payment he goes deeper next time, enters the body and demands ten thousand then a lakh, meaning small losses now prevent larger harm later. The sums are only the analogy.
classical_check: Silent; the idea that a graha takes a smaller tax in place of a greater one appears in remedial tradition.

hindi: यह बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है तो लेकिन ऐसे में पित दोष काउंटर नहीं होता लेकिन इसका ऐसे में बॉडी तो बचेगी
says: This is very important, but doing it this way does not counter pitru dosha; it only saves the body from harm, so the dosha still needs its own remedy.
ambiguity: This contradicts the end of the previous chunk where the sacrifice was said to save pitru dosha; here he limits it to the body.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: पित दोष में बच्चे की बली ले ली
says: In pitru dosha the planet takes its sacrifice from the child, meaning the trouble falls on the children's matters of the native.
cells_derived_method: The 5th house shows children and the sign on it changes the flavour: fire signs give risk to the first child, water signs to emotions of children.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna (5-5+1=1), 5th house Leo with the dosha, ego clashes with children.
Derived: Cancer lagna (8-5+1=4), 5th house Scorpio, intense and secretive child issues.

ambiguity: Whether the child sacrifice means child health, delay, or study is not said.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: pitru dosha is classically tied to loss or delay of children.

hindi: यह प्रेम का भाव है ये बहुत इंपोर्टेंट होता है लव सारे लव अफेयर यहीं से होते हैं
says: The 5th house is the house of love and is very important; all love affairs come from here.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 5th shows the style of romance: Leo proud, Scorpio intense, Capricorn reserved, Aquarius detached.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, 5th house in Leo, loves with pride and need for admiration.
Derived: Cancer lagna, 5th in Scorpio, intense and secretive romances.
Derived: Virgo lagna (10-5+1=6), 5th in Capricorn, slow and serious romance.
Derived: Libra lagna (11-5+1=7), 5th in Aquarius, friendship-like and detached love.

ambiguity: The word this is a pointer; the 5th house is inferred from the next sentences where he names it.
classical_check: Agrees: the 5th house is the house of romance and children.

hindi: आपने कोई कमी नहीं छोड़ी थी मां बाप का आशीर्वाद था आपके साथ लेकिन नसीब का क्या करें यह पांचवे घर की डिस्टरबेंस होने से लव अफेयर नहीं हो पाते
says: You left no shortfall and had the blessing of your parents, but what to do with fate: a disturbance of the 5th house is what stops love affairs from happening.
cells_derived_method: The disturbing planet and the sign alter the kind of failure: Saturn gives delay, Mars gives quarrels, Rahu gives deceit.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, 5th in Leo with Saturn, love delayed and cold.
Derived: Cancer lagna, 5th in Scorpio disturbed, jealousy blocks the affair.
Derived: Libra lagna, 5th in Aquarius disturbed, partner stays aloof.

ambiguity: Disturbance is not defined; presumably affliction by malefic or debilitation.
classical_check: Agrees that an afflicted 5th hurts romance.

gist: Joke dialogue of a lover who says he gave true love and got not even false love back, the girl saying she does not love him.
Joke continues: he says make any relation, even a sister, just make a relation and I will live.

hindi: यहां सच्चा प्यार आपका यह खराब है तो आपको लोग प्यार नहीं करेंगे
says: If this house of true love (the 5th) is bad, people will not love you.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 5th sets how: Leo repels by ego, Capricorn by coldness, Virgo by criticism.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus lagna (6-5+1=2), 5th house in Virgo bad, love lost to criticism and fault-finding.
Derived: Virgo lagna, 5th in Capricorn bad, partner finds the native cold.

ambiguity: This is read as the 5th house; he points at the chart.
classical_check: Agrees in general.

hindi: अगर य मंगल 10 नंबर आ गया तो आपको फ्री फंड में प्यार मिल रहा है
says: If Mars comes to number 10 (Capricorn, where it is exalted), you will get love free of cost, without effort.
cells_derived_method: The house Capricorn falls in changes who gives the love: lagna = 10 minus house plus 1.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn lagna, exalted Mars in the lagna, personal charm draws love.
Derived: Libra lagna (10-4+1=7), exalted Mars in the 4th, love through home and mother.
Derived: Cancer lagna (10-7+1=4), exalted Mars in the 7th, partner is passionate.
Derived: Aries lagna, exalted Mars in the 10th, love comes through work and status.

ambiguity: Number 10 could be the 10th house; since sign numbering is used in this series it is read as Capricorn, which is also Mars's exaltation.
classical_check: Agrees that exalted Mars is strong; free love is his interpretation.

gist: A listener asks for a romantic class where several relationships would come one by one.
Banter: it is a matter of courage, everyone wants it but nobody says it, nobody has the guts, not even to blink.
A listener says only you can fix my longing, I am in pain myself.
Question: you said Mars brings much love, so is attachment also in Mars?

hindi: मंगल अरे बड़ी प्यारी बात अटैचमेंट मंगल इज द प्लेनेट ऑफ डी अटैचमेंट
says: Mars is the planet of detachment, not attachment; he welcomes the question and answers that Mars stands for de-attachment.
ambiguity: Caption reads de attachment; it could be de-attachment or attachment, but the next sentences show he means detachment.
classical_check: Differs: classically Mars is courage and aggression; detachment is not a standard Mars karakatva.

hindi: हम ये सोच नहीं पाते ना अगर मंगल आपको ज्ञानी बना जाता है तो आप कहते हो भाड़ में जाए
says: If Mars turns you into a wise person you start saying let it all go to hell; a well working Mars gives knowledge in the form of carelessness toward worldly attachment.
ambiguity: The sentence runs into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मंगल की पॉजिटिविटी है जब आप भाड़ में जाए सीखते हैं ... हो जाए तो अच्छा ना होए तो और भी अच्छा एक्सपेक्टेशन खत्म हो गई
says: The positive side of Mars is when you learn to say let it go: if it happens fine, if not even better, so expectation ends; Mars positivity equals freedom from expectation.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Slogan painted on the back of trucks: if it happens good, if not even better; used as illustration.

hindi: किसी भी धागे में जैसा आपकी कुंडली अलाव करती है लॉकेट डालो यहां पर रख लो साथ जेब में रखो हाथी दांत होना चाहिए
says: The ivory piece can be tied in any coloured thread as your own kundali allows, or worn as a locket, or simply kept in the pocket; the main point is that ivory should be with you.
ambiguity: The first words of the sentence are garbled; the thread colour that the chart permits is left to the individual chart.
classical_check: Silent; ivory is not a classical remedy and its trade is illegal in India, recorded only as his claim.

hindi: राहु के साथ एसोसिएट करते हैं इसको लेकिन अब क्या इसमें डिस्क्राइब करें बता दिया हमने एक्सप्लेनेशन के लिए तो राहु की क्लास में करेंगे
says: Ivory is associated with Rahu, but the reason is left for the Rahu class; he has only mentioned it here.
classical_check: Silent; ivory under Rahu is not classical.

hindi: अगर अटैचमेंट है तो मोह है ना मोह है तो माया में फसे हुए हो आप
says: Where there is attachment there is moha, and where there is moha you are caught in maya; attachment equals illusion.
classical_check: Silent; spiritual idea rather than a Jyotish rule.

hindi: मोह में हो तो थाइज परो इंद्र ना भी गई तेल लेने क्योंकि आपके जो है मोह ही माया से तो मोह होगा और मोह तो सबसे ज्यादा इंद्र को है
says: Moha belongs most of all to Indra (Uranus) in his scheme, and the thighs are linked to it in the garbled opening; if you are in moha, the planet in charge is Indra.
ambiguity: The words thighs pro Indra are garbled; the thigh link is uncertain.
classical_check: Differs: Uranus is not in classical Jyotish; classical moha is Venus or Rahu.

hindi: मंगल हनुमान जी को तो मोह नहीं है कहीं भी वह तो अपनी तपस्या में लीन है
says: Mars, as Hanuman, has no attachment anywhere and stays absorbed in his own penance; the Mars deity stands for the detached ascetic.
classical_check: Agrees that Hanuman is the deity associated with Mars in the tradition; the ascetic detachment is his emphasis.

hindi: माया में फसा मोह में फसा व्यक्ति मूलाधार के ही निचले एरिया पर है
says: A person trapped in maya and moha lives only in the lower area of the muladhara chakra, the base of the spine; his consciousness does not rise.
ambiguity: Mars is named only by context; muladhara is Mars's chakra in his scheme.
classical_check: Silent; chakras are yogic, not Jyotish classical.

hindi: उसकी लाइफ में तो कड़ा करकट होगा तभी तो दुख मिलता है
says: Such an attached person's life will be full of rubbish and that is why he gets sorrow; attachment causes suffering.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: All these unhappy people keep our shop running by their grace, said to the crowd.
Dialogue of a mother worried about her 17 year old son, shown as attachment; even grandchildren do not obey their fathers.
Man weeping over the family property left by grandfather that even his father did not get; and over a five-lakh loss that was never an actual profit.

hindi: ज्ञान कब होगा जब आप कहोगे भाड़ में जाए याद रख लो सूत्र हमें क्या लेना देना
says: Remember the sutra: knowledge comes only when you can say let it go to hell, what is it to me; detachment is the door to gyan.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप नाभी से नीचे गिरोगे नहीं और मंगल महाराज ने संभाल लिया
says: You will not fall below the navel and Mars Maharaj has held you up; a strong Mars keeps a person from sinking into the lower centres.
ambiguity: The first words are at the end of the previous chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपका ब्लड प्रेशर सेट है
says: With Mars holding you your blood pressure stays set; he links Mars to blood pressure. This is his claim and not a medical statement.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the karaka of blood.

hindi: घुटनों में क्रोध रहता है सोचो जब गुस्सा आता तो क्या होता है हाथ पाव कापते हैं आपके
says: Anger lives in the knees; when anger comes the hands and legs shake, which is why he places the Mars anger at the knees and lower limbs.
classical_check: Silent; Kalapurusha gives the knees to Capricorn, ruled by Saturn.

hindi: मंगल महाराज अग्नि तत्व आपका कहां काम कर रहा है घुटनों और पैरों में जा रहा है
says: The fire element of Mars works through the knees and legs; the fire of Mars goes down to the knees and feet.
classical_check: Agrees that Mars is a fire planet.

hindi: भय रहता है भय कहां रहता है प्लूटो पैर के पंजे
says: Fear resides in Pluto (Yama in his scheme) and its seat is the toes of the feet; fear is a Pluto thing.
classical_check: Differs: Pluto is outside the classical nine; the 12th house or Saturn would carry fear and the feet.

gist: Story of running when a lion appears and the feet freezing when a ghost appears, used to show fear in the feet.

hindi: आप कितना नीचे गिरोगे नाभी से नीचे नहीं जाना ना जान रहेगी आपने मुक्का मार के शेर का दांत तोड़ दोगे यह है विल पावर
says: You can only fall so far, not below the navel, or life will be gone; with the will you could even punch a lion and break its tooth, and that is willpower, which he places at the navel under Mars.
classical_check: Silent; Mars as willpower is a modern reading of its courage karakatva.

hindi: इस विल पावर के दम के ऊपर आपका काम होता है यही है विल पावर जो बच्चे में यदि है तो पेपर देकर आता है कहता खेलने जा रहा हूं
says: Your work gets done on the strength of willpower; a child who has it gives the exam and goes off to play, while one without it worries about the result; Mars willpower means freedom from anxiety over outcomes.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Otherwise the child hopes in his result and in the examiner who checks his paper.
Mahabharata example: Krishna tells Arjuna to focus on his arrows, while Duryodhana begs Bhishma and Karna to win for him.

hindi: तुम्हारा खुद पर कितना विश्वास है आपका स्वयं पर शक्ति होनी चाहिए मेरा भाई यह कर देगा बेटा वो कर देगा क्या जरूरत है उनकी
says: How much trust do you have in yourself; power must come from within and not from a brother or a son who will do it for you, so why depend on them; self-reliance is the Mars quality.
ambiguity: Mars is named only through the earlier willpower talk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अपनी ऊर्जा स्वयं में रखना ही नाभि पर एकत्रित करना है इसी से औरा स्ट्रांग होती है औरा यहीं से स्ट्रांग होती है
says: Keeping your energy within yourself is the same as collecting it at the navel, and this is what makes the aura strong; the aura strengthens from the navel.
classical_check: Silent; navel (manipura) energy is yogic.

hindi: थर्ड आई पर सूर्य और चंद्र बैठे हैं सूर्य बैठा है ये सूर्य है ये तीसरा नेत्र नीचे को देखता है नाभी पे
says: The third eye is discussed in the Sun class because the Sun and Moon sit at the third eye; the Sun is that third eye, which looks down toward the navel.
ambiguity: The caption merges two sentences; Sun is said as the eye and Moon beside it.
classical_check: Silent; Sun and Moon as the two eyes is classical (Sun right eye, Moon left), but the third eye assignment is his own.

hindi: यहां भी अग्नि और यहां भी ये अग्नि पहचानता है
says: There is fire at the third eye and there is fire at the navel, and fire recognises fire; the two centres are linked by their fire.
ambiguity: Caption is thin; the linking claim is read from context.
classical_check: Silent; Sun and Mars are both fire planets, which agrees.

hindi: आंख बंद करके कलर दिख रहे हैं कल्पना हो रही है कहां से लाइट आ रही है देखने के लिए लाइट चाहिए ... अंदर भी लाइट है वो लाइट नाभी से चलती है वो बिजली यहां से आती है हमारी
says: With eyes shut we still see colours, and seeing needs light, so there is an inner light; that light, an electricity, starts from the navel, which he gives to Mars.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए मंगल आपका शरीर शोष शरीर की ताकत यह सब देगा
says: So Mars will give you the body and its strength and vigour; he sums up Mars as the giver of physical strength and energy.
ambiguity: A word before body strength is garbled, possibly vigour.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is karaka of strength and vigour.

gist: Says one or two more points were left out of the Mars talk; the chunk ends with a cut sentence.

hindi: मंगल से सिर्फ विल पावर होती है
says: From Mars you get only willpower; he narrows Mars to will, and says speech and expression come from other planets.
ambiguity: The first word of the sentence is in the previous chunk; sentence read as Mars gives only willpower.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is karaka of courage and drive; the narrow claim is his.

hindi: अगर आप बोलने में लाजवाब हो तो बुध बहुत अच्छा है
says: If you are superb at speaking, Mercury is very good in your chart; the quality of speech is read from Mercury.
cells_derived_method: The house Mercury is in shows where the speech works: the 2nd and 3rd are the speech houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus lagna (3-2+1=2), Mercury in own sign Gemini in the 2nd gives a fluent, persuasive voice.
Derived: Mercury in own sign Virgo in the 3rd (lagna 6-3+1=4, Cancer) gives sharp, witty communication.

classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the karaka of speech.

hindi: आपका एक्सप्रेशन बहुत चुनिंदा है तो चंद्रमा बहुत कमाल है
says: If your expression is very refined and well chosen, the Moon is excellent; the Moon decides the quality of expression of feeling.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Moon is karaka of mind and emotion; expression through the Moon is his reading.

hindi: जिन बच्चों का मंगल अच्छा है वो शार्प होते हैं ... उसका पांचवे चौथे घर से लिंक है वेरी शार्प अगर वो नहीं भी पढ़ेगा लिखेगा तो शार्प जरूर रहेगा रॉकेट की तरह उठेगा
says: Children with a good Mars are sharp; it is linked to the 4th, 5th (and perhaps 6th) house; even if he does not study he stays sharp and will rise like a rocket.
cells_derived_method: Mars in own or exalted sign in the study houses gives the sharpness; lagna = sign minus house plus 1.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius lagna (1-5+1=-3, 9), Mars in own sign in the 5th, quick intellect.
Derived: Libra lagna (10-4+1=7), exalted Mars in the 4th, drive in learning and home.
Derived: Gemini lagna (8-6+1=3), Mars in own sign in the 6th, competitive and sharp.

ambiguity: The caption says 5th, six, 4th garbled; the houses are read as 4, 5 and possibly 6.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars in the 4th or 5th is classically mixed; sharpness is his reading.

hindi: उसका चंद्रमा दूषित होगा तो आता तो है लिखने में नंबर अच्छे नहीं आएंगे
says: If the child's Moon is afflicted he knows the answers but does not get good marks in writing; a bad Moon spoils written marks.
cells_derived_method: Moon afflicted by sign or house: debilitated in Scorpio, or with Saturn or Rahu, or in the 6th, 8th, 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer lagna (8-5+1=4), Moon debilitated in the 5th, knows the matter but marks are low.
Derived: Virgo lagna (1-8+1=-6, 6), Moon in the 8th in Aries, anxious in writing.

classical_check: Silent; Moon as the source of memory and neat writing is a general karaka reading.

hindi: चंद्रमा अच्छा है और बुद्ध खराब है तो उसको लिखने में नंबर अच्छे आएंगे बोल नहीं सकता कहेंगे यार ये जड्डू है किताबी कीड़ा टाइप
says: If the Moon is good and Mercury is bad the child scores well in writing but cannot speak; he is called a dull bookworm type who cannot talk.
cells_derived_method: Mercury weak by debilitation in Pisces or by affliction in the speech houses 2 and 3.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aquarius lagna (12-2+1=11), debilitated Mercury in the 2nd, speech weak.
Derived: Capricorn lagna (12-3+1=10), debilitated Mercury in the 3rd, expression and presentation weak.

classical_check: Silent; the Mercury-speech and Moon-memory split is his own.

hindi: फर्स्ट तो अलग अलग ग्रह कार्य कर रहे हैं आपके
says: First point: different planets are working different functions in you, so willpower, speech and expression each have their own planet and must be read separately.
classical_check: Agrees with the karaka idea.

gist: A listener recalls something was left, the pitru dosha related to Mars and to the 5th house, and he confirms.

hindi: पांचवें घर के दोषी हो जाने से पितरों का दोष है
says: When the 5th house becomes faulty, that is the fault of the ancestors, meaning pitru dosha is read from the 5th house.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 5th changes which fault matters, see the next rows where signs 6, 7 and 8 are named.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, faulty 5th in Leo, fault comes through pride and authority of the father line.
Derived: Scorpio lagna (12-5+1=8), 5th house in Pisces, fault through emotional and spiritual neglect of ancestors.

classical_check: Differs: classically the 9th is the main house of ancestors and pitru dosha; he ties it to the 5th.

hindi: पांचवें घर पर कैसे भी किसी भी कंडीशन में आपकी कुंडली घूमकर मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली भी अगर चल रही है या 2/3/4 भी चल रहा है
says: On the 5th house, in any condition, even if your chart turns out to be a Munna Bhai chart (one running several lagnas, here lagna signs 2, 3 and 4), the 5th house is still to be checked.
cells_derived_method: Lagna signs 2, 3, 4 (Taurus, Gemini, Cancer) put signs 6, 7, 8 (Virgo, Libra, Scorpio) on the 5th. lagna = sign minus 5 plus 1.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Taurus lagna (6-5+1=2), the 5th house is Virgo.
Derived: Gemini lagna (7-5+1=3), the 5th house is Libra.
Derived: Cancer lagna (8-5+1=4), the 5th house is Scorpio.

ambiguity: Munna Bhai chart is his nickname for a multi-lagna chart; the caption is garbled; the signs 6, 7, 8 on the 5th are his next sentences.
classical_check: Silent on multi-lagna charts as a name; houses spanning more than one sign is consistent with bhava chalit.

hindi: यहां पर किसी भी किस्म से आपका ग्रह नेगेटिव राशि आ गई अगर यहां दो नंबर राशि है तो यहां आठ है नौ है और ये 10 है मान लो तीन लगन चल रहे हैं
says: If a planet comes in a negative sign in any manner in this house, then with three lagnas running the same house shows different signs in different charts (he lists signs 2, 8, 9, 10 as examples); each variant must be checked.
ambiguity: The board shows which sign sits in which box; the numbers 2, 8, 9, 10 cannot be placed from the caption.
classical_check: Agrees that bhava chalit and rashi charts give different house occupants.

gist: Says he will take one chart sometime to show how KP and chalit charts are decided; it is tough and complicated, the Munna Bhai chart; deferred.

hindi: चलो बनाकर आपका 6 सात आठ चलेगा तो अब लगा लो कितने ग्रहों से आपको पितृ दोष लग सकता है
says: With the 5th house running signs 6, 7 and 8 (Virgo, Libra, Scorpio) now count how many planets can give you pitru dosha; each of the three signs has its own triggering planets.
cells_derived_method: Each of the signs gives its own planets: Libra with debilitated Sun, Virgo with debilitated Venus, and Scorpio with the next listed planets.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini lagna, 5th in Libra, Sun debilitated there triggers the dosha.
Derived: Taurus lagna, 5th in Virgo, Venus debilitated there triggers the dosha.

classical_check: Differs from classical pitru dosha, which is not counted this way.

hindi: सात नंबर अगर सूर्य की यहां दृष्टि है या बैठा है तो भी पितृ दोष हो गया
says: If the Sun sits in or aspects sign number 7 (Libra, where the Sun is debilitated) in the 5th house, that too is pitru dosha.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated Sun in Libra in other houses: lagna = 7 minus house plus 1; the area hit moves with the house, not the pitru rule he states for the 5th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra lagna, debilitated Sun in the lagna, self and father line.
Derived: Aquarius lagna (7-9+1=-1, 11), debilitated Sun in the 9th, father and fortune.
Derived: Capricorn lagna (7-10+1=-2, 10), debilitated Sun in the 10th, authority and career.

ambiguity: Aspect or sitting on the 5th is meant; the Sun aspect lands from the 11th house on the 5th.
classical_check: Agrees that a debilitated Sun is the classical sign of weak father line.

hindi: छह नंबर शुक्र बैठा या दृष्टि है यहां से तो भी हो गया पितृ दोष
says: If Venus sits in or aspects sign number 6 (Virgo, where Venus is debilitated) in the 5th house, that also is pitru dosha.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Venus in Virgo in other houses: lagna = 6 minus house plus 1.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo lagna, debilitated Venus in the lagna, charm and comfort drained.
Derived: Gemini lagna (6-4+1=3), debilitated Venus in the 4th, home comforts weak.
Derived: Pisces lagna (6-7+1=0, 12), debilitated Venus in the 7th, spouse issues.

classical_check: Differs: Venus is not a classical pitru dosha cause.

hindi: यहां पर है तो शनि की दृष्टि है शनि बैठा है प्लूटो है नेप्चून है आपको पितृ दोष लगेगा
says: For the third sign (read as 8, Scorpio) the pitru dosha comes if Saturn aspects or sits there, or Pluto or Neptune is there.
cells_derived_method: Which house and the chart: Scorpio on the 5th is Cancer lagna; Saturn aspects the 5th from the 3rd, 8th and 11th houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer lagna, Saturn in Scorpio in the 5th, the child and ancestors line.
Derived: Virgo lagna (8-3+1=6), Saturn in Scorpio in the 3rd aspects the 5th by its 3rd aspect.
Derived: Capricorn lagna (8-11+1=-2, wraps to 10), Saturn in Scorpio in the 11th aspects the 5th by its 7th aspect.

ambiguity: The word here is a pointer; assumed sign 8 following 7 and 6.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn on the 5th gives trouble; Pluto and Neptune are outside the classical set.

gist: Remark on how big a problem this is.

hindi: इंद्र भी है इंद्र की दृष्टि है तो पित्र कृपा भी मिलेगी
says: If Indra (Uranus) is also there or aspects, the blessing of the ancestors is also received; Uranus on the 5th brings ancestral grace along with the trouble.
classical_check: Differs: Uranus is outside classical Jyotish.

hindi: ऐसे में ये हाल होगा भगवान ने रोटी से ऊपर उठने नहीं दिया पर रोटी की कमी कभी दी नहीं
says: In such a case the result is that God never lets you rise above bread but never gives a shortage of bread; life stays at the level of basic livelihood without want.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether it sums up the pitru dosha or the grace of Indra in the previous line.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Banter question: how is your bread; the answer begins in the next chunk.
Someone says: central AC house, four cars, but no driver to drive them.

hindi: शुक्र गाड़ी है मंगल ड्राइवर है
says: Venus is the car and Mars is the driver; Venus stands for the comforts and Mars for the one who handles them.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus is the karaka of vehicles; Mars as the handler is his analogy.

hindi: आपकी गाड़ी बहुत अच्छी है ड्राइवर नालायक है वो बढ़िया गाड़ी भी ठोक देगा
says: If Venus is excellent but Mars is poor, the driver is useless and will crash even a good car; good comforts get wasted or damaged by a bad Mars.
cells_derived_method: Strong Venus in own or exalted sign with Mars in debilitation or in a dusthana.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, Venus in its own sign in the 7th. Mars is separately weak in the 4th, so comforts exist but handling is poor.
Derived: Pisces lagna, Venus exalted in the lagna, with Mars in the 8th: great comforts, but Mars damages them.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आपकी गाड़ी बिल्कुल थकी हुई है हमारा साजो सामान घर है भोग विलास की चीजें सब शुक्र है और ड्राइवर बिल्कुल कमाल का है
says: A worn-out car with a brilliant driver: Venus covers household things and luxuries; when it is weak but Mars is strong the means are modest but managed superbly.
cells_derived_method: Weak Venus (debilitated in Virgo) with strong Mars (exalted in Capricorn or own sign).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, Venus weak by sign in the 6th. Mars is separately strong in the 10th, so few luxuries but excellent upkeep.
Derived: Libra lagna (6-12+1=-5, 7), Venus weak by sign in the 12th. Mars is separately strong, so modest means are managed well.

classical_check: Agrees that Venus is karaka of luxury and household comforts.

hindi: घर के गृहणी पुरुष ऐसे होते हैं कहते हैं यार दो कमरे का घर है इनका ... फाइव स्टार होटल में नहीं पर्दे लगे होते हैं जैसे इन्होने सलीके से रखे एक चीज खराब नहीं दिखेगी
says: Some couples have only a two room home but keep it like a five-star hotel with curtains and everything in place; he reads this as the driver being good, a strong Mars.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह ड्राइवर के ऊपर है मंगल दूषित है जैसे काम संभाल लो
says: It all depends on the driver; when Mars is afflicted the upkeep and handling of the home and the work fail.
ambiguity: The last words about taking care of the work are unclear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जिन घरों में साफ सफाई बढ़िया है ... परफेक्शनिस्ट मंगल स्ट्रांग है सब चीजें करीने से हैं दराज के अंदर है
says: Homes with great cleanliness where everything is arranged, kept in drawers, belong to a perfectionist, so Mars is strong in that person.
ambiguity: A phrase in the middle is garbled.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उस घर के अंदर लोगों के पेट ठीक है पता नहीं कैसे
says: In such an orderly house, people's stomachs are in order too, he says, without knowing why; a strong Mars goes with a good digestion. This is his observation, not a medical claim.
classical_check: Silent; Mars as digestive fire is a general Ayurvedic-Jyotish link.

hindi: जिन घरों के अंदर सामान फैला हुआ है यानी कि मंगल डिस्टर्ब है पेट खराब होगा ये स्वाभाविक सी चीजें मिलेंगी आपको
says: Homes where things are scattered mean Mars is disturbed and stomach trouble will be found; he calls these natural findings. The stomach item is his claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह आपके व्यवहार को भी चला रहा है आपके घर को भी चला रहा है आपके जीवन को भी चला रहा है
says: Mars runs your behaviour, your home and your life; the planet is the driver for all three.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is the karaka of action and the home in the sense of the 4th house aspect.

hindi: इसके लिए विल पावर चाहिए स्ट्रेंथ चाहिए और मंगल की मदद कौन करेगा या तो राजा सूर्य या गुरु बृहस्पति
says: For this Mars needs willpower and strength, and its helpers are the king Sun or the guru Jupiter; those two planets support Mars.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun and Jupiter are friends of Mars in the classical friendship table.

hindi: सेनापति फॉलो करता है सेनापति इफ बट नहीं करता क्यों कैसे राजा ने कह दिया करो राजा की सुनो या गुरु को प्रणाम करता है
says: Mars is the commander who follows orders without if and but; he obeys what the king says or bows to the guru, so he is steady under Sun or Jupiter.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the commander (senapati) in the planetary cabinet.

hindi: सूर्य यहां से थर्ड आई से शक्ति देता है नेत्र सारे उसके पास है देखने की शक्ति जीवन की सारी ऊर्जा के पास है
says: The Sun gives power from the third eye; all the eyes and the power of sight belong to the Sun, and so does the energy of life.
classical_check: Agrees that the Sun is karaka of eyes and vitality.

hindi: बृहस्पति इसके ठीक नीचे बैठा जल तत्व कार्य करके दे रहा है मंगल को
says: Jupiter sits right below that, working as the water element and supplying it to Mars; in his body map Jupiter is water at the navel area supporting Mars fire.

classical_check: Differs: Jupiter is classically ether, not water.

hindi: शुक्र पूर्ण पावर देता है मंगल शुक्र कॉमिनेशन बहुत अभी कॉमिनेशन की बात
says: Venus also gives Mars full power; the Mars and Venus combination is a big topic that he does not take up now.
classical_check: Differs partly: Venus and Mars are neutral to each other classically.

hindi: गंडमूल छह नक्षत्र होते हैं नक्षत्रों की तो क्लास अलग ही है बात करेंगे

hindi: मूल नक्षत्र है मघ नक्षत्र है ये अश्लेष है जब छह नक्षत्र होते हैं तो उसमें मूलों में जन्म कहा जाता है

hindi: ऐसे भारी नक्षत्र होते हैं कि उस नक्षत्र में पैदा किया पता लगा बच्चा वहां पैदा हुआ और मामा और नाना नानी के घर के अंदर बैंड बज गई
says: These are heavy nakshatras: a child born in them brings trouble for the maternal uncle and the maternal grandparents' house.

gist: Says nakshatras have great depth, KP goes inside them; teach it to me first; he is half joking.

hindi: रिप्रोडक्टिव केतु की राशियां दृष्टियां यहीं से निकली है पता नहीं क्या-क्या निकला है

hindi: नहीं शुक्र का है शादी करने की आपकी इच्छा नहीं हो रही शुक्र का है
says: No, it is Venus; if you do not feel like getting married, that is a Venus matter and not a Mars dosha.
cells_derived_method: Venus weak or afflicted by sign or house: debilitated in Virgo, in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or with Saturn or Rahu.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces lagna (6-7+1=0, 12), debilitated Venus in the 7th, little wish for marriage.

hindi: या आपकी सेक्सुअल प्रेफरेंसेस डिस्टर्ब है या आपके घर के अंदर एन एन डब् डिस्टर्ब है

hindi: अगेंस्ट है यानी सेवंथ हाउस और फिफ्थ हाउस के अंदर इनके नपुंसक प्लेनेट पड़े हुए
says: Being actively against marriage means that neuter planets (napunsak grahas) are lying in the 7th and 5th houses of the person.
cells_derived_method: Classical neuter planets are Mercury and Saturn; the sign and lagna decide which. Lagna = sign minus house plus 1.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sagittarius lagna (3-7+1=-3, 9), Mercury in own sign in the 7th, a talkative neutral partner and little wish.
Derived: Cancer lagna (10-7+1=4), Saturn in own sign in the 7th, cold and delayed marriage.
Derived: Taurus lagna (6-5+1=2), Mercury in own sign in the 5th, romance becomes intellectual.

ambiguity: Which planets are called napunsak is not in the caption; the sentence is cut at the end.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury and Saturn are classically neuter and weaken the 7th house results.

hindi: मैंने नहीं करनी और ऐसे आदमी जबरदस्त अफेयर में पिटे होते हैं ए अफेयर अनसक्सेसफुल क्या होगा मेरा तो मनुष्यता से विश्वास ही उठ गया
says: People who firmly declare they will not marry have usually been badly beaten in a failed love affair and have lost faith in humanity; he links the refusal to marry to a broken affair.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer lagna (8-5+1=4), afflicted 5th in Scorpio, a deep betrayal in love.
Derived: Cancer lagna (10-7+1=4), afflicted 7th in Capricorn, a cold or rejecting partner.

hindi: यह इतने घमंडी लोग होते हैं दे कांट टेक नो फॉर एन आंसर इनको यह बर्दाश्त नहीं होता कि मेरे को ना कैसे कह दिया उसने
says: Such people are very proud and cannot take no for an answer; they cannot bear that someone refused them and after that will not risk loving again because a broken heart would be unbearable.

classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सप्तम भाव के अंदर आपका कोई ना कोई ग्रह या किसी ग्रह की दृष्टि है या बैठा है जो नेगेटिव है जो मल्टीपल सेक्स रिलेशंस है वो 12वां भाव और सप्तम भाव के डिस्टरबेंस से है

hindi: अगर यह आपको शरीर पुरुष का मिल गया और पंचम भाव के अंदर कोई ग्रह नेगेटिव है तो आपका पंचम भाव लिबिडो यह टूट जाएगा
